blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Local Binary Patterns (LBP) remain among the most widely used texture descriptors, from industrial inspection to medical imaging. Yet their radius, sampling angles, color transform and thresholds are fixed by hand for each dataset. We present FLEX-LBP, which learns these parameters by backpropagation while every forward pass computes exact binary codes and hard histogram counts. A straight-through estimator acts only in the backward pass, so the deployed descriptor is an interpretable hard-binary LBP with 90 learnable parameters and unchanged inference cost. In a controlled ablation on six color texture benchmarks, the component worth learning is dataset-dependent. One configuration, applied unchanged everywhere, learns the geometry and thresholds with the color transform frozen. It improves the nearest-neighbor accuracy of the identical fixed descriptor by 3.55 points on average over five seeds, significantly on five of six benchmarks and never significantly worse. With a linear discriminant readout, it gains 0.9 points; the fully learned descriptor gains 2.7 and has the highest mean. FLEX-LBP is more accurate than five classical LBP-family descriptors, PCANet and a neural LBP on five of six benchmarks. Its mean nearest-neighbor accuracy exceeds that of frozen ImageNet ResNet-50 features (23.5 million parameters). On the Kather colorectal cancer histology benchmark, the fully learned descriptor reaches 93.8%, significantly above the best classical descriptor (Completed LBP, 92.8%). The learned radii adapt in directions that recur across seeds. Noise drowns single-pixel comparisons and illuminant change flips inter-channel ones; median sampling or gray-world normalization restores 96-97%. The code is available as a drop-in PyTorch layer at https://github.com/medalimoussa/FLEX-LBP.
blocks.zh: 从工业检查到医疗成像,当地二进制图案(LBP)仍然是最广泛使用的纹理描述符之一. 然而,它们的半径、采样角度、颜色变换和阈值是用手固定每个数据集的。 我们提出FLEX-LBP,它通过反向传播来学习这些参数,而每一个前传都计算精确的二进制代码和硬直方图计数. 直通估计器只在后传中进行行为,所以部署的描述器是可解释的硬二进制LBP,有90个可学习参数,推论成本不变. 在六种颜色纹理基准的控制下,值得学习的组件依赖于数据集. 一个配置,随处应用不变,随颜色变冷而学习几何和阈值. 它提高了相同固定描述符的近邻准确度,平均在5个种子上提高3.55分,在6个基准中的5个基准上显著提高,而且从未出现过显著的更差. 有了线性歧视读数,它得到0.9分;完全学习的描述器得到2.7分,并且有最高的平均值. FLEX-LBP比五个经典的LBP-家族描述符,PCANet和一个神经LBP更准确,分六个基准中的五个. 它的平均近邻精度超过了冻结的ImageNet ResNet-50特性(2,350万参数). 在Kather色谱癌组织学基准中,完全学习的描述语达到93.8%,大大高于最好的古典描述语(完成LBP,92.8%). 所学的光圈在种子之间反复出现的方向上适应。 噪声会淹没单像素的比较,光亮的变化会翻转通道之间的比较;中位采样或灰世界正常化恢复96-97%. 该代码作为滴入式PyTorch层可访问https://github.com/medalimoussa/FLEX-LBP.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Local Binary Patterns (LBP) [ Ojala et al., 2002b ] are among the most widely used texture descriptors, with applications ranging from industrial surface inspection [ Mäenpää et al., 2003 ] and medical image analysis [ Nanni et al., 2010 ] to remote sensing [ Li et al., 2015 ] and face recognition [ Ahonen et al., 2006 ] ; Pietikäinen et al. [2011] review many more.
An LBP operator compares each pixel with neighbors on a circle around it, packs the comparison bits into an integer code and describes the image by the histogram of these codes.
LBP are cheap to compute, invariant to monotonic gray-level changes and geometrically interpretable.
These properties matter most when a task offers only a few hundred to a few thousand training images and the descriptor must be auditable.
Large pretrained networks are then not an obvious choice: they bring millions of parameters learned on other data, and their features cannot be read off.
blocks.zh:
本地二元图案(LBP)[Ojala等人,2002年b]是最广泛使用的纹理描述词之一,其应用范围从工业表面检查[Mäenpää等人,2003年]和医疗图像分析[Nanni等人,2010年]到遥感[Li等人,2015年]和面对识别[Ahonen等人,2006年];Pietikäinen等人[2011年]审查更多.
一个LBP操作员将每个像素与周围的邻居比较,将比较位数打包成整数代码,并通过这些代码的直方图描述图像.
LBP在计算上是便宜的,对单调的灰色水平变化不具有变化性和几何解释性.
这些属性在一项任务只提供几百到几千个训练图像,且描述符必须可审计的情况下最为重要.
大型的预先训练的网络当时并不是一个明显的选择:它们带来了从其他数据上学到的数百万个参数,它们的特性无法读取.

blocks.en:
The weakness of LBP is configuration: the classical operator fixes its radius, angular sampling directions, color-space transform, comparison threshold and intensity quantization before any data is seen.
Each new material, imaging setup or dataset therefore requires an expert to re-tune these choices by grid search, and the optimum does not transfer.
In our ablation, a change that improves one benchmark by several points degrades another by as much (Section 4.4 ).
We address this tuning step and ask three questions.
(Q1) Which components of the LBP pipeline are worth learning from data, and does the answer depend on the dataset?
(Q2) How much of the gain over a classical LBP comes from learning, and how much from descriptor postprocessing and the readout?
(Q3) Do the learned parameters remain interpretable?
blocks.zh:
LBP的弱点是配置:古典操作员在看到任何数据之前,先修正其半径,角采样方向,色空间变换,比较阈值和强度的量化.
因此,每个新的材料、成像设置或数据集都需要一位专家通过网格搜索重新调整这些选择,最佳方法不会转移。
在我们的考虑中,一个基准改善若干点的改变使另一个基准下降同样多(第4.4节)。
我们处理这个调试步骤,提出三个问题。
(问题1) LBP管道中哪些组成部分值得从数据中学习,答案是否取决于数据集?
(问题2) 一个经典的LBP的利润多少来自学习,以及描述后处理和读出多少?
(问题3) 学到的参数是否仍然可以解释?

blocks.en:
Prior work approaches the problem from two sides.
Learned methods such as Binarized Statistical Image Features (BSIF) [ Kannala and Rahtu, 2012 ] and Local Binary Convolutional Neural Networks [ Juefei-Xu et al., 2017 ] replace the radius, angle and color parameters of LBP with generic learned filters, or embed binary comparisons in deep networks.
Hand-designed extensions such as Completed LBP (CLBP) [ Guo et al., 2010a ] , Robust LBP (RLBP) [ Chen et al., 2013 ] and Median Robust Extended LBP (MRELBP) [ Liu et al., 2016 ] show that the design space matters but do not learn it.
Neural LBP variants come closest: they learn sampling positions [ Lin et al., 2020 ] or relaxed thresholds [ Peeples et al., 2026 ] inside deep networks.
Their deployed feature, however, is no longer a histogram LBP whose radius, angles, thresholds and color basis can be read off (Section 2 ).
blocks.zh:
先前的工作是从双方着手解决问题的。
Binarized Statistical Image Features (BSIF) [Kannala and Rahtu, 2012] 和本地二元革命神经网络[Juefei-Xu等人,2017年] 等学习方法,将LBP的半径,角度和颜色参数替换为通用的学习滤波器,或在深层网络中嵌入二元比较.
手工设计的扩展,如已完成的LBP(CLBP)[Guo等人,2010年a],Robust LBP(RLBP)[Chen等人,2013年]和Medien Robust扩展LBP(MRELBP)[Liu等人,2016年]显示设计空间很重要,但没有学习.
神经LBP变体最接近:它们学会了取样位置[Lin等人,2020年]或深层网络内部的放松阈值[Pepeples等人,2026年].
然而,它们部署的特征不再是直方图LBP,其半径、角度、阈值和颜色基础可以读取(第2节)。

blocks.en:
We introduce FLEX-LBP (Feature Learning with EXact Local Binary Patterns), which keeps the classical multi-scale histogram descriptor, computed by three parallel branches.
As in opponent color LBP (OCLBP) [ Mäenpää and
Pietikäinen, 2004 ] , each branch compares the center pixel in one color channel with its neighbors in the same or another channel.
Following CLBP, each channel pair yields a sign and a magnitude histogram, which form the sign-plus-magnitude LBP (SM-LBP) descriptor of the branch.
FLEX-LBP learns five components by backpropagation: (i) a per-branch 3 × 3 3{\times}3 color transform; (ii) radii bounded to scale-specific ranges; (iii) ordered sampling angles that cover the full circle; (iv) per-direction comparison thresholds that generalize the zero threshold of classical LBP, in the spirit of Local Ternary Patterns (LTP) [ Tan and Triggs, 2010 ] ; and (v) the number of intensity quantization levels.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了FLEX-LBP(Feature Learning with EXact Local Binary Patterns),它保留了经典的多比例直方图描述符,由三个平行分支计算.
与对手的颜色相同,LBP(OCLBP)[Mäenpää和
Pietikäinen, 2004]),每个分支在一个彩色频道中将中像素与它的邻居在同一个频道或另一个频道中进行比较.
继CLBP之后,每个通道对生成一个标志和一个大小直方图,这构成了该分支的标志加放大LBP(SM-LBP)描述符.
FLEX-LBP通过反向传播学习5个组件:(一)每个分支3×3 3×Times}3个颜色变换;(二)与尺度特定范围结合的放射线;(三)命令覆盖全圆的采样角度;(四)按照当地特伦特定型(LTP)[Tan and Triggs,2010]的精神,将古典LBP的零阈值概括化的每个方向比较阈值;以及(五)强度四分级水平的数量.

blocks.en:
Binary comparison and histogram binning are not differentiable, so we train with a straight-through estimator (STE) [ Bengio et al., 2013 ] .
Every forward pass, in training as at test time, computes exact binary codes and hard histogram counts, and surrogate derivatives act only in the backward pass.
blocks.zh:
二进制比较和直方图二进制是没有区别的,因此我们用直通式估计器(STE)进行训练[Bengio等人,2013年].
每一次前传,在测试时间的训练中,都会计算精确的二进制代码和硬直方图计数,代位衍生物只在后传中行为.

blocks.en:
We evaluate FLEX-LBP on six color texture benchmarks: NewBarkTex [ Porebski et al., 2014 ] , KTH-TIPS2-b [ Caputo et al., 2005 ] , Outex TC13 and TC31 [ Ojala et al., 2002a , Université de Lille, 2022 ] , Parquet [ Bianconi et al., 2013 ] and USPtex [ Backes et al., 2012 ] .
Fixed and learned descriptors receive the same postprocessing (uniform-pattern projection and power normalization [ Perronnin et al., 2010 ] ) and are classified by standardized one-nearest-neighbor (1-NN) matching.
Under the same protocol, we compare FLEX-LBP with five classical and two learned LBP-family descriptors, and in accuracy and cost with frozen ImageNet ResNet-50 features [ He et al., 2016 ] .
We also analyze two Outex suites with photometric shifts (TC32, additive noise; TC34, illuminant change) on which the color descriptor fails.
Finally, we apply FLEX-LBP to the colorectal cancer histology benchmark of Kather et al. [2016] .
To our knowledge, FLEX-LBP is the first texture descriptor that learns its sampling radii and angles, its comparison thresholds and its color transform from labeled data while the deployed operator keeps exact binary codes and histogram counts.
blocks.zh:
我们评价FLEX-LBP的六个颜色纹理基准:NewBarkTex [Porebski等人,2014年],KTH-TIPS2-b [Caputo等人,2005年],Outex TC13和TC31 [Ojala等人,2002年a,Lille大学,2022年],Parquet [Bianconi等人,2013年]和USPtex [Backes等人,2012年].
固定和有学识的描述器获得同样的后处理(统一-平面投影和电源正常化[Perronnin等人,2010年]),并按标准化的近邻(1-NN)匹配进行分类.
根据同一协议,我们将FLEX-LBP与5个古典和2个学习过的LBP-家族描述符进行比较,并在准确性和成本上与冻结的ImageNet ResNet-50功能[He等人,2016年]进行比较.
我们还分析两套带有光度变化的Outex套房(TC32,添加式噪音;TC34,光亮变化),其颜色描述器失效.
最后,我们将FLEX-LBP应用于Kather等人的结肠癌组织学基准[2016].
据我们所知,FLEX-LBP是第一个从标签数据中学习其采样光度和角度、其比较阈值和颜色变化的纹理描述器,而部署的操作员则保留精确的二进制代码和直方图计数。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: 1. We propose FLEX-LBP, an LBP whose 90 stored parameters can be learned by backpropagation while every forward pass stays exactly binary. The deployed descriptor is thus a hard-binary SM-LBP with 3,186 3{,}186 dimensions after postprocessing and the inference cost of the fixed operator (Section 3 ). 2. We report a controlled component ablation with paired significance tests over training seeds. The best learned component depends on the dataset, but one configuration, Geometry, which learns the sampling geometry and the thresholds with the color transform frozen, is applied unchanged to every benchmark. Over five seeds, it improves the 1-NN accuracy of the identical fixed descriptor by + 3.55 +3.55 percentage points (pp) on average. The gain is significant on five of the six main benchmarks, and the learned descriptor is never significantly worse. It also improves the fixed descriptor on histology, a benchmark added after it was chosen (Sections 4.4 – 4.6 and 4.9 ). 3. We separate the contributions of postprocessing, readout and learning. On the six main benchmarks, postprocessing adds + 2.02 +2.02 pp on average to the fixed descriptor, and learning the geometry adds + 3.55 +3.55 pp on top of it. With a supervised linear discriminant analysis (LDA) readout instead of 1-NN, the gain of the learned geometry falls to + 0.92 +0.92 pp, whereas the fully learned descriptor keeps + 2.68 +2.68 pp. LDA also lifts the fixed descriptor above the learned geometry read out by 1-NN on four of the six main benchmarks (Sections 4.5 and 5.3 ). 4. With the geometry learned, FLEX-LBP is more accurate than the strongest classical descriptor on five of the six main benchmarks. Averaged over seeds, it is also more accurate than the two learned ones, PCANet [ Chan et al., 2015 ] and the neural LBP (NLBP) of Peeples et al. [2026] , on all six. With LDA on every descriptor, FLEX-LBP is again ahead on five of the six, but MRELBP then leads on KTH-TIPS2. Fully learned, it reaches 93.8% on eight-class colorectal cancer histology, significantly above CLBP (92.8%). A fixed LTP coding in the same pipeline matches the learned geometry on average. We trace most of its advantage over our SM-LBP code to its absolute dead zone (Sections 4.7 and 4.9 ). 5. Against the frozen ResNet-50 features (23.5 million parameters), the learned geometry has the higher mean accuracy over the six main benchmarks with 1-NN (83.10% against 80.85%). With LDA, the two means are similar (87.44% against 86.74%), and the fully learned descriptor has the highest mean (89.07%), but both leads rest on Parquet. The ResNet-50 features are more accurate on KTH-TIPS2, USPtex and, with LDA, NewBarkTex. Without input remedies, they are also more accurate under the photometric shifts; with the same remedies, the best remedied FLEX-LBP descriptor is significantly ahead on both suites (Section 4.10 ). 6. We show that the learned radii, angles and thresholds remain explicit, bounded or regularized parameters whose direction of adaptation recurs across seeds. We trace the failures under noise and illuminant change to the input representation, with input-side remedies whose cost elsewhere we measure (Sections 4.8 and 5 ). The code is available at https://github.com/medalimoussa/FLEX-LBP .

ResNet-50的特性在KTH-TIPS2,USPtex和与LDA,NewBarkTex上更为精确. 在没有输入补救的情况下,光度变化也更准确;如果有同样的补救,两个套房中补救最好的FLEX-LBP描述符都大大领先(第4.10节)。 6. 我们显示,所学的弧度、角度和阈值仍然是明确的、有界限的或规范化的参数,其适应方向在种子中反复出现。 我们把噪音和光辉变化下的失败追踪到投入说明中,并用投入方的补救措施,我们在其他地方衡量其成本(第4.8和5节)。 该编码可在https://github.com/medalimoussa/FLEX-LBP上查阅。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Against the frozen ResNet-50 features (23.5 million parameters), the learned geometry has the higher mean accuracy over the six main benchmarks with 1-NN (83.10% against 80.85%). With LDA, the two means are similar (87.44% against 86.74%), and the fully learned descriptor has the highest mean (89.07%), but both leads rest on Parquet. The ResNet-50 features are more accurate on KTH-TIPS2, USPtex and, with LDA, NewBarkTex. Without input remedies, they are also more accurate under the photometric shifts; with the same remedies, the best remedied FLEX-LBP descriptor is significantly ahead on both suites (Section 4.10 ).
blocks.zh: 对照冻结的ResNet-50特性(2 350万个参数),所学几何的平均精度高于6个主要基准的1-NN(83.10%,80.85%)。 有了LDA,这两种手段相似(87.44%对86.74%),而完全学习的描述符的平均值最高(89.07%),但两者都以Parquet为主. ResNet-50的特性在KTH-TIPS2,USPtex和与LDA,NewBarkTex上更为精确. 在没有输入补救的情况下,光度变化也更准确;如果有同样的补救,两个套房中补救最好的FLEX-LBP描述符都大大领先(第4.10节)。

blocks.en: We show that the learned radii, angles and thresholds remain explicit, bounded or regularized parameters whose direction of adaptation recurs across seeds. We trace the failures under noise and illuminant change to the input representation, with input-side remedies whose cost elsewhere we measure (Sections 4.8 and 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们表明,所学的弧度、角度和阈值仍然是明确、有界限或正规化的参数,其适应方向在种子之间反复出现。 我们把噪音和光辉变化下的失败追踪到投入说明中,并用投入方的补救措施,我们在其他地方衡量其成本(第4.8和5节)。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Classical LBP and its hand-designed extensions
blocks.zh: 2.1 经典LBP及其手工设计的扩展

blocks.en:
CLBP [ Guo et al., 2010a ] decomposes local differences into sign, magnitude and center components and shows that magnitude complements sign.
LTP [ Tan and Triggs, 2010 ] replace the zero threshold by a hand-tuned symmetric dead zone, which yields a three-valued code.
RLBP [ Chen et al., 2013 ] flips unreliable bits, and MRELBP [ Liu et al., 2016 ] replaces point sampling with local median patches.
LBP variance [ Guo et al., 2010b ] , dominant LBP [ Liao et al., 2009 ] , cross-scale co-occurrence LBP (CS-CoLBP) [ Xiao et al., 2025 ] , regional gradient patterns (RGP) [ Wang et al., 2025 ] and sparse LBP for event-sensor data [ Fardo and Rodrigues, 2024 ] widen the design space further.
Classical descriptors, LBP included, remain competitive when data is scarce or interpretability is required [ Liu et al., 2019 ] .
Recent variants adapt scale and sampling through hand-crafted local statistics (EMSABP [ Gupta et al., 2026 ] , SPALBP [ Hu et al., 2024 ] , SARLBP [ Upadhyay et al., 2025 ] ).
All these methods fix their adaptation rule at design time, and the adaptive ones re-estimate their sampling per pixel.
FLEX-LBP instead learns one global set of radius, angle, threshold and color parameters from labeled data (Supplementary Section S8 compares these design dimensions).
blocks.zh:
CLBP [Guo等人,2010年a]将局部差异分解成标志,规模和中心组件,并显示该规模补充标志.
LTP [Tan and Triggs, 2010] 以手调对称的死区取代零阈值,产生三值码.
RLBP [Chen等人,2013年]翻转不可靠的位点,MRELBP [Liu等人,2016年]用本地中位补丁取代点采样.
LBP 差异 [Guo等人,2010b],主要 LBP [Liao等人,2009年],跨尺度共聚LBP (CS-CoLBP) [Xiao等人,2025年],区域梯度模式 (RGP) [Wang等人,2025年],事件传感器数据的稀疏LBP [Fardo and Rodrigues,2024年]进一步扩大了设计空间.
包括LBP在内的经典描述符在数据稀缺或需要可解释性时仍然具有竞争力[刘等人,2019].
最近的各种变体通过手工制作的当地统计来适应规模和取样情况(EMSABP[Gupta等人,2026年],SPALBP[Hu等人,2024年],SARLBP[Upadhyay等人,2025年])。
所有这些方法在设计时都固定了它们的适应规则,适应性方法则重新估计它们每个像素的采样.
FLEX-LBP转而从标签数据中学习一组全局的半径,角度,阈值和颜色参数(补充部分S8比较这些设计维度).

blocks.en: 2.2 Learned binary features and deep texture representations
blocks.zh: 2.2 学到的二进制特征和深层纹理表现

blocks.en:
BSIF [ Kannala and Rahtu, 2012 ] binarizes the responses of generic linear filters learned from natural images by independent component analysis (ICA), not from labeled texture data.
Local Binary Convolutional Neural Networks [ Juefei-Xu et al., 2017 ] and LBPNet [ Lin et al., 2020 ] build binary comparisons into deep networks, and LBPNet learns its sampling positions end to end for character and object recognition.
NLBP [ Peeples et al., 2026 ] combines a sigmoid-relaxed threshold, learned 1 × 1 1{\times}1 bit-weight combinations and a soft histogram layer [ Peeples et al., 2022 ] .
These relaxations stay active at inference, so its deployed feature is no longer an LBP.
PCANet [ Chan et al., 2015 ] , a learned counterpart of LBP coding, learns two stages of convolution filters by principal component analysis (PCA) without labels and pools their binarized responses into histograms.
FLEX-LBP differs from these methods in two respects.
First, straight-through estimation keeps its forward pass exactly binary.
Second, it learns only a few bounded or regularized descriptor parameters per branch, each of which can be inspected.
blocks.zh:
BSIF [Kannala and Rahtu, 2012]通过独立组件分析(ICA),而不是从标注的纹理数据,将从自然图像中吸取的通用线性滤波器的响应二进制.
本地二元革命神经网络[Juefei-Xu et al., 2017]和LBPNet[Lin et al., 2020]将二元比较构建到深层网络中,LBPNet学习其采样位置结束为字符和对象识别.
NLPP [Peeples et al., 2026] 结合了一个Sigmoid-松动的阈值,学习了 1×1 ×1 ×1 × 1位重的组合和软直方图层 [Peeples et al., 2022].
这些放松在推论中保持活跃,所以其部署的特征不再是LBP.
PAPNet [Chan et al.,2015],LBP编码的学习对等者,通过主元件分析(PCA)学习两个阶段的演化滤波器,没有标签,将其二进制的响应集合到直方图中.
FLEX-LBP在两个方面不同于这些方法.
首先,直截了当的估计 保持它的前进 完全二进制。
第二,它只学习到每个分支的几个有界限或正规化的描述参数,每个参数都可以检查.

blocks.en:
Convolutional neural network (CNN) representations dominate texture recognition when training data is plentiful.
Generic convolutional activations transfer well to texture [ Cimpoi et al., 2016 , Andrearczyk and Whelan, 2016 ] , Deep TEN [ Zhang et al., 2017 ] adds a learned residual encoding and bilinear CNNs [ Lin et al., 2015 ] model second-order interactions.
Many applied tasks, however, offer only small labeled sets, as in virus texture recognition [ Kylberg et al., 2011 ] , and this is the regime we target.
Training-free encodings such as RADAM [ Scabini et al., 2023 ] reach about 90–91% on color Outex TC13, but they rely on large pretrained ConvNeXt backbones and expose no descriptor parameters that can be inspected.
We do not aim to replace large-scale deep models; we ask how far learning can improve an interpretable LBP that needs no backbone.
blocks.zh:
革命神经网络(CNN)的表示在训练数据充裕时主导纹理识别.
一般性的转录活化能很好的转移到纹理[Cimpoi等人,2016年,Andrearczyk和Whelan,2016年],Deep TEN [Zhang et al., 2017] 添加了已学习到的残余编码和双线CNNs [Lin et al., 2015] 模式二阶互动.
然而,许多应用任务只提供少量标签,如病毒纹理识别[Kylberg等人,2011年],这就是我们的目标制度。
RADAM[Scabini等人,2023年]等无培训编码在彩色Outex TC13上达到约90–91%,但它们依赖于经过事先训练的大型ConvNEXt骨干,并暴露出无法检查的描述参数.
我们的目的不是要取代大规模的深层模型;我们问学习能在多大程度上改进一个不需要骨干支撑的可解释的LBP.

blocks.en: 2.3 Training objectives and histogram postprocessing
blocks.zh: 2.3 培训目标和直方图后处理

blocks.en:
Because evaluation uses nearest-neighbor matching, the training objective must shape the descriptor space for retrieval.
Neighborhood Components Analysis (NCA) [ Goldberger et al., 2005 ] optimizes a soft nearest-neighbor objective, Proxy-NCA [ Movshovitz-Attias et al., 2017 ] introduces scalable class proxies and additive-margin cosine losses [ Wang et al., 2018 ] add a margin to the class score.
For postprocessing, power normalization was introduced for Fisher vectors [ Perronnin et al., 2010 ] and also benefits compact codes [ Jégou et al., 2012 ] .
blocks.zh:
由于评价使用近邻匹配,训练目标必须塑造描述符空间进行检索.
邻接组件分析(NCA)[Goldberger等人,2005年]优化了近邻柔软的目标,Proxy-NCA[Movshovitz-Attias等人,2017年]引入可伸缩类亲和添加剂-边际联赛亏损[Wang等人,2018年]在班级积分中增加了比值.
在后处理方面,对费舍尔矢量实行了功率正常化[Perronnin等人,2010年],还实行了优惠紧凑代码[Jégou等人,2012年]。

blocks.en: 2.4 Color and multi-scale texture descriptors
blocks.zh: 2.4 颜色和多比例纹理描述符

blocks.en:
Most LBP work treats the mapping from color to gray as fixed preprocessing, although no single color space dominates across datasets [ Porebski et al., 2013 ] .
Other descriptors keep several color spaces and select among the resulting features [ Alimoussa et al., 2019 ] , as the compact hybrid multi-color space (CHMCS) descriptor [ Alimoussa et al., 2022 ] does across LBP and co-occurrence families.
Color information is strongly material-dependent [ Burghouts and Geusebroek, 2009 ] , which supports comparisons between color channels as well as within them.
Adding spatial interactions between channels to those within channels generally improves texture classification, in color and even more in hyperspectral images [ Porebski et al., 2022 ] .
OCLBP [ Mäenpää and
Pietikäinen, 2004 ] keeps one ordering of each inter-channel pair because opposing pairs such as R–G and G–R are highly redundant.
Improved OCLBP [ Bianconi et al., 2018 ] thresholds against the local average instead of the center.
Multi-scale concatenation of two or three fixed configurations of K K neighbors at radius R R outperforms any single scale [ Ojala et al., 2002b ] .
FLEX-LBP combines these ideas: each branch learns a linear color transform, compares all nine intra- and inter-channel pairs and learns its scale within an ordered, bounded range.
blocks.zh:
LBP作品大多将从颜色到灰色的映射视为固定的预处理,尽管没有单一的彩色空间在数据集之间占主导地位[Porebski 等人,2013].
其他描述符保留了数个色彩空间,并在由此产生的特征中选择[Alimoussa等人,2019年],像紧凑的混合多彩空间(CHMCS)描述符[Alimoussa等人,2022年]一样,跨LBP和共聚家庭.
色彩信息高度依赖材料[Burghouts and Geusebroek,2009],它支持色彩通道之间以及内部的比较.
将通道之间的空间相互作用加到通道内部的通道上,一般会改善纹理分类,在色彩上,在超光谱图像上甚至更多[Porebski等人,2022].
OCLBP [墨西哥
Pietikäinen, 2004)] 保留每对通道间对的订单,因为R-G和G-R等对立对的对子非常冗余.
改进了OCLBP[Bianconi等人,2018年]相对于当地平均值而不是中心阈值.
在半径R R 上对 K 邻接的两三个固定配置进行多尺度的调和,超过任何单一的尺度[Ojala等人,2002b].
FLEX-LBP融合了这些想法:每个分支学习一个线性颜色变换,比较所有9个通道内和通道间对子,并在一个有序,界限范围内学习其尺度.

blocks.en: 2.5 Texture analysis in histopathology
blocks.zh: 2.5 组织病理学中的纹理分析

blocks.en:
In histopathology, the hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) stain makes tissue classes differ in color as well as in structure. Kather et al. [2016] released a colorectal cancer texture benchmark and reached 87.4% with combined gray-level descriptors, LBP included, and a support vector machine.
Stain color varies between laboratories, scanners and staining batches, which motivates stain normalization [ Reinhard et al., 2001 , Macenko et al., 2009 ] and color augmentation [ Tellez et al., 2019 ] .
Whether color normalization helps depends on whether training and test images differ in color.
blocks.zh:
在组织病理学中,血氧素和eosin(H&E)的污点使组织类别在颜色和结构上有所不同. 凯瑟尔等人. [2016] 发布了一个色谱癌纹理基准,并达到了87.4%,结合了灰色水平描述符,LBP包含,以及支持矢量机.
不同实验室、扫描仪和污迹批次的污迹颜色各不相同,这促使污迹正常化[Reinhard等人,2001年,Macenko等人,2009年]和色彩增强[Tellez等人,2019年]。
色彩正常化是否帮助取决于训练和测试图像是否在色彩上有所不同.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We first recall the classical LBP and state what FLEX-LBP learns (Section 3.1 ).
We then describe the architecture, the operator and the parameters of each learned component (Sections 3.2 – 3.5 ).
Finally, we explain how gradients cross the binary steps (Section 3.6 ) and state the training objective (Section 3.7 ) and the postprocessing and classification (Section 3.8 ).
We write descriptor and parameter vectors in bold and matrices in upper case.
blocks.zh:
我们首先回顾传统的LBP,并说明FLEX-LBP学到了什么(第3.1节)。
然后,我们描述每个知识组成部分的架构、操作符和参数(第3.2至3.5节)。
最后,我们解释梯度如何跨越二进制步骤(第3.6节),并说明培训目标(第3.7节)和后处理和叙级(第3.8节)。
我们用粗体写下描述符和参数矢量,在大写中写上矩阵。

blocks.en: 3.1 From the classical LBP to FLEX-LBP
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 从经典的LBP到FLEX-LBP

blocks.en:
The classical LBP [ Ojala et al., 2002b ] describes a texture by how each pixel compares with its surroundings.
Around each pixel p p of a gray-level image x x , it samples K K neighbors on a circle of radius R R , at the evenly spaced angles θ k = 2 ​ π ​ k / K \theta_{k}=2\pi k/K .
Each neighbor yields one bit: 1 if it is at least as bright as the center pixel and 0 otherwise.
The K K bits of a pixel are packed into one integer code, LBP K , R ( p ) = ∑ k = 0 K − 1 2 k [ x ( p + Δ k ) − x ( p ) ≥ 0 ] , \mathrm{LBP}_{K,R}(p)=\sum_{k=0}^{K-1}2^{k}\,\mathbf{1}\!\left[x(p+\Delta_{k})-x(p)\geq 0\right], (1) where Δ k = R ⁡ ( cos ⁡ θ k , sin ⁡ θ k ) \Delta_{k}=R\,(\cos\theta_{k},\sin\theta_{k}) is the offset of the k k -th neighbor and 𝟏 ​ [ ⋅ ] \mathbf{1}[\cdot] equals 1 if its condition holds and 0 otherwise.
Neighbors at non-integer positions are read by bilinear interpolation.
With K = 8 K{=}8 , each pixel receives a code between 0 and 255 that names its local pattern, such as an edge or a corner.
The descriptor of the image is the 256-bin histogram of these codes over all its pixels.
blocks.zh:
古典的LBP[Ojala等人,2002b]用每个像素与其周围的对比来描述纹理.
它在半径 R R 的圆形上, 以均匀的间距角 = 2 π k / K\theta_{k}=2\ pi 来取样 K K 邻居 (单位:千美元)
每个邻居产生一个比特:1,如果它至少和中心像素一样亮,否则0.
像素的 K K 位点被打包成一个整数代码, LBP K, R (p) = ∑ k = 0 K − 1 2 k [x (p + + +  k k ) − x (p ) → 0],\ mathrm{ LBP}_{K,R}(p)=\sum_{k=0}^{K-1}K}2^{k}\,\mathbf{1}\!!\左[x(p+\Delta_{k})-x(p)\geq 0\右],(1) ΔK = R⁡(cos⁡k, sin⁡k)\Delta_{k\R\,(\cos\theta_{k},\sin\theta_{k})是k-th邻和1[⋅]\mathb{1}[\cdot]等于1,如果其状况维持在 0 。
非整数位置的邻居通过双线插值读取.
用 K = 8 K{=}8,每个像素得到一个0到255之间的代码,以命名其局部图案,如边缘或角.
图像的描述符是这些代码在所有像素上的256位直方图.

blocks.en:
This operator leaves five choices to its designer: the radius R R , the sampling angles θ k \theta_{k} , the comparison threshold (zero in Eq. ( 1 )), the input color space and the number of gray levels.
FLEX-LBP keeps the stages of this operator and learns these five choices by backpropagation.
It has three branches, each with 30 learnable parameters, 90 in total.
A branch stores nine values of a color transform, four radii (the sampling distance can differ mildly along four axes), eight angles, eight thresholds and one number of gray levels.
The experiments compare configurations that learn subsets of these parameters (Section 4.2 ).
FLEX-LBP also adopts two established extensions of the operator: the sign-plus-magnitude coding of CLBP [ Guo et al., 2010a ] and the comparisons between color channels of OCLBP [ Mäenpää and
Pietikäinen, 2004 ] .
Because the forward pass still computes hard comparisons and exact histogram counts, inference costs the same as a fixed multi-scale color LBP with the same sampling (timings in Section 4.3 ).
Fig. 1 summarizes the pipeline on one real USPtex texture.
blocks.zh:
这个操作员给其设计者留下了五个选择:半径R R,采样角度 θ k\theta_{k},比较阈值(0 in Eq. (1)),输入颜色空间和灰度数.
FLEX-LBP保持这个操作器的阶段,通过反向传播来学习这五个选择.
它有三个分支,每个分支都有30个可学习参数,总共90个.
一个分支存储着颜色变换的9个值,4个弧度(采样距离可以沿4个轴略微不同),8个角度,8个阈值和1个灰度.
实验比较了学习这些参数子集的配置(第4.2节).
FLEX-LBP还采用了经营者的两个既定扩展:CLBP的标志加宽编码[Guo等人,2010年a]和OCLBP的色通道的比较[Mäenpää和
Pietikäinen, 2004)] (英语).
由于前传仍然计算硬度比较和精确的直方图计数,推论的成本与具有相同抽样的固定多比例色LBP(第4.3节的计数)一样.

blocks.en: 3.2 Multi-branch architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2 多处建筑

blocks.en:
FLEX-LBP has three parallel branches that sample the input image at different radii, and thus at different spatial scales: fine, mid and coarse.
Each branch b ∈ { fine , mid , coarse } b\in\{\mathrm{fine},\mathrm{mid},\mathrm{coarse}\} applies its own learnable color transform and LBP operator to the RGB input image x ∈ ℝ 3 × H × W x\in\mathbb{R}^{3\times H\times W} .

The SM-LBP operator extends Eq. ( 1 ) in two ways.
First, following the CLBP decomposition [ Guo et al., 2010a ] , it produces two codes instead of one: one encodes the sign of the center–neighbor difference and the other its magnitude.
The sign pattern captures local ordinal structure such as edges and corners, while the magnitude pattern records the strength of local contrast, which is discriminative on material and bark textures [ Guo et al., 2010a , Liu et al., 2019 ] .

blocks.en: 3.6 Differentiability: straight-through estimator
blocks.zh: 3.6 可区分性:直通估计器

blocks.en:
Training needs the derivative of the loss with respect to every descriptor parameter.
Two steps of the SM-LBP pipeline, however, are piecewise constant: the comparison that produces a bit and the counting that turns codes into a histogram.
Their derivatives are zero almost everywhere, so plain backpropagation of the training loss ℒ \mathcal{L} (Section 3.7 ) would leave every LBP parameter unchanged.
Soft bits or soft histograms in the forward pass would provide gradients, but the trained descriptor would then differ from the deployed one and would no longer be an LBP.
blocks.zh:
培训需要每个描述参数的损失衍生物。
然而,SM-LBP输油管的两个步骤是片面常数的:产生一点的比较和将代码变成直方图的计数.
它们的衍生物几乎无处不在,因此L\mathcal{L}(第3.7节)训练损失的简单反射会使每个LBP参数保持不变.
前传中的软位或软直方图会提供梯度,但经过训练的描述符随后会与部署的描述符不同,而不再是LBP.

blocks.en:
We therefore use the STE [ Bengio et al., 2013 , Hubara et al., 2016 ] , which keeps the forward pass exact and changes only the backward pass.
For a piecewise-constant operation q ⁡ ( u ) q(u) , we choose a smooth approximation q ~ ​ ( u ) \tilde{q}(u) , its surrogate, and the network computes q STE ​ ( u ) = q ⁡ ( u ) + q ~ ​ ( u ) − sg ⁡ [ q ~ ​ ( u ) ] , q_{\mathrm{STE}}(u)=q(u)+\tilde{q}(u)-\mathrm{sg}\!\left[\tilde{q}(u)\right], (9) where the stop-gradient operator sg ⁡ [ ⋅ ] \mathrm{sg}[\cdot] returns its argument in the forward pass and has zero derivative.
The last two terms cancel in the forward pass, so q STE ​ ( u ) = q ​ ( u ) q_{\mathrm{STE}}(u)=q(u) exactly, while backpropagation uses ∂ q STE / ∂ u = q ~ ′ ​ ( u ) \partial q_{\mathrm{STE}}/\partial u=\tilde{q}\,^{\prime}(u) .
In other words, the network computes with the exact step and differentiates as if it were the smooth surrogate.

Because all surrogates act only in the backward pass, the descriptor computed during training is the one used at test time.
It is a hard-binary LBP at the learned ( M b , 𝒓 b , 𝜽 b , 𝝎 b , L b ) (M_{b},\boldsymbol{r}_{b},\boldsymbol{\theta}_{b},\boldsymbol{\omega}_{b},L_{b}) , whose parameters can be read off.
Recomputing the bits, codes and histogram counts of Fig. 1 from the intensities sampled by the model, with integer bit packing and counting, reproduces the model output exactly for all 27 channel pairs.
The color transform and the bilinear interpolation remain floating-point operations, as in any interpolated LBP, so the exactness concerns the binary coding and counting, not the sampled intensities.
With its color transform and thresholds, FLEX-LBP is a generalized LBP rather than a classical LBP with other radii; what it shares with the classical operator is exact hard-binary inference.
Like every STE, the estimator is biased, which can make learning slower or less effective but cannot make the deployed descriptor differ from the one that was trained and evaluated.

blocks.en:
All experiments use a proxy-only descriptor-learning objective [ Movshovitz-Attias et al., 2017 ] .
Each class has one learned unit vector, its proxy, and the loss pulls the descriptor of an image toward the proxy of its class and away from the others.
All discriminative pressure therefore comes from one metric-learning loss on the ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized descriptor, without a classification head or data augmentation, which isolates the effect of learning on the descriptor.

ℒ geom \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{geom}} keeps the geometry physically plausible: it combines a quadratic pull of the radii toward their initialization, a penalty on angular gaps below 0.3 rad and a mild pull of the angles toward the standard LBP directions, with relative weights 1, 0.5 and 0.3. blocks.en: Before classification, two transformations are applied to the histograms, identically for fixed and learned descriptors.

blocks.en:
Following Ojala et al. [2002b] , each 256-bin histogram block is projected onto the uniform patterns (denoted u2), the codes with at most two bitwise transitions around the circle.
For K = 8 K{=}8 this reduces each block from 256 to 59 bins: 58 uniform patterns and one bin that pools all non-uniform codes, which merges the noisy tail of rare patterns.

Element-wise power normalization [ Perronnin et al., 2010 ] is then applied to the projected descriptor 𝒛 \boldsymbol{z} , z ^ n = sign ⁡ ( z n ) ​ | z n | α , 𝒛 ^ ← 𝒛 ^ / ‖ 𝒛 ^ ‖ 2 , \hat{z}_{n}=\mathrm{sign}(z_{n})\,|z_{n}|^{\alpha},\qquad\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}\leftarrow\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}/\|\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}\|_{2}, (15) with α = 0.7 \alpha{=}0.7 , which compresses the dynamic range of the bins and up-weights rare patterns.
The postprocessed descriptor has 3 × 9 × 2 × 59 = 3,186 3\times 9\times 2\times 59=3{,}186 dimensions.

Descriptors are z z -score standardized with training-set statistics and classified by exact Euclidean nearest-neighbor matching, which we call standardized 1-NN.
This non-parametric readout measures the geometry of the descriptor space without any learned classifier and is the primary metric throughout the paper.
As a second readout, we fit an LDA on the standardized training descriptors, with the covariance shrinkage set automatically by the Ledoit–Wolf estimator [ Ledoit and Wolf, 2004 ] .
LDA has no hyperparameter to tune but, unlike 1-NN, is a classifier fitted to the labeled training data.

这种非参数读出测量了描述器空间的几何图形,没有任何学习过的分类器,是整篇论文的主要衡量标准.
作为第二次宣读,我们安装了标准化培训描述符的LDA, 列多伊特-沃尔夫估计器自动设定了共变收缩 [列多伊特和沃尔夫, 2004].
LDA没有超参数调谐,但与1-NN不同,它是符合标注的训练数据的分类器.

blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en:
We evaluate on nine benchmarks (Table 1 , Fig. 3 and Supplementary Section S19).
Six texture benchmarks of bark, materials, wood and general textures form the main evaluation, and two Outex suites with photometric shifts are analyzed separately.
A colorectal cancer (CRC) histology benchmark, Kather-CRC, serves as an application.

我们评价了9项基准(表1,图3和补充部分S19)。
树皮、材料、木材和一般纹理的6个纹理基准构成主要评价,另外对两个带有光度变化的Outex套房分别进行分析。
结肠癌(CRC)组织学基准Kather-CRC作为一种应用。

blocks.en:
NewBarkTex [ Porebski et al., 2014 ] (six bark classes) uses its official split, and USPtex [ Backes et al., 2012 ] (191 classes of general textures) the standard decomposition distributed by the LISIC laboratory. KTH-TIPS2-b [ Caputo et al., 2005 , Mallikarjuna et al., 2006 ] , KTH-TIPS2 hereafter, holds out physical sample a of each of its 11 materials as the test set and trains on the other three samples.
This is the easier of the two common KTH-TIPS2 conventions, so published results that train on a single sample are not directly comparable to ours. Parquet [ Bianconi et al., 2013 ] holds 38 classes of wood flooring (14 species in 2–4 visually similar grades), with six images per class.
We train on the first three images of each class and test on the last three.
This fixed split differs from the alternating split of the public LISIC decomposition, so our Parquet results are not directly comparable to published ones. Outex : in the original color suite TC13 [ Ojala et al., 2002a ] , the training and test images are acquired under identical conditions.
In the extended Outex suites TC31, TC32 and TC34 [ Université de Lille, 2022 ] , which share their training images (Inca illuminant, 100 dpi), the test images differ in one controlled factor.
This factor is the spatial resolution in TC31 (120 dpi), additive Gaussian noise ( σ = 5 \sigma{=}5 ) in TC32 and the illuminant in TC34 (Horizon and TL84).
Fig. 3 a shows one texture under the four conditions.
blocks.zh:
NewBarkTex [Porebski等人,2014年] (六个树皮类)使用其正式分解, USPtex [Backes等人,2012年] (191类一般纹理) LISIC实验室分配的标准分解. KTH-TIPS2-b [Caputo等人,2005年,Mallikarjuna等人,2006年],KTH-TIPS2,以下按其他三个样品的试验组和列车分别按其11种材料的物理样本进行。
这是两种常见的KTH-TIPS2公约中比较容易的,因此公布的在单一样本上进行训练的结果不能直接与我们的比较. Parquet [Bianconi等人,2013年] 拥有38类木地板(14种2–4目视相似等级),每类有6幅图像.
我们在每个班级的前三个图像上进行训练,并在后三个班上进行测试.
这种固定的拆分不同于公共LISIC分解的交替拆分,因此我们的Parquet结果不能直接与公布的结果相比. Outex:在最初的彩色套件TC13[Ojala等人,2002a]中,培训和测试图像是在相同条件下获得的.
在扩展的Outex套房TC31,TC32和TC34[里尔大学,2022年]中,这些套房分享了他们的训练图像(Inca lumiminant,100 dpi),测试图像在一个控制系数上有所不同.
此因子是TC31(120 dpi)中的空间分辨率,TC32中的添加剂高斯噪音(σ = 5\sigma{=}5)和TC34中的亮度(Horizon和TL84).

blocks.en:
TC32 and TC34 change the photometry of the test images rather than their texture.
Our color descriptor is invariant to neither change by design.
We therefore analyze these two suites separately (Section 4.8 ), report them in every table and exclude them from the averages over the main benchmarks.
This grouping was decided after their results and their diagnosis were known.

TC32和TC34改变了测试图像的光度测量,而不是其纹理.
我们的颜色描述符 无论是设计上还是设计上 都没有变化
因此,我们分别分析这两套套套房(第4.8节),在每张表格中报告,并将其排除在主要基准的平均数之外。
这种分类是在他们的结果和诊断出来之后决定的。

blocks.en:
Kather-CRC [ Kather et al., 2016 ] , named after its first author and colorectal cancer, contains 5,000 RGB tiles of 150 × 150 150{\times}150 pixels cut from ten H&E-stained slides, 625 for each of eight tissue classes (Fig. 3 b).
Our five folds, like the ten of Kather et al. [2016] , are formed at the tile level, so tiles of one slide and of neighboring regions fall into both training and test folds.
The benchmark therefore measures recognition within ten slides from one center, not generalization to new patients.
blocks.zh:
Kather-CRC [Kather等人,2016年],以其第一作者和结肠癌命名,包含5 000个RGB瓷砖,面积为150×150 150×Times}150像素从10个H&E沾染的幻灯片中切除,8个组织类各625个(图3b).
我们的五叠像Kather et al. [2016] 的十叠一样,在瓦片层面形成,因此一个幻灯片和邻近区域的瓦片既属于训练,也属于测试折叠.
因此,该基准从一个中心算出10个幻灯片,而不是向新病人概括。

blocks.en: 4.2 Ablation design
blocks.zh: 4.2 设计

blocks.en:
All configurations share the architecture, the proxy-only loss of Eq. ( 13 ), the optimizer and the evaluation protocol (standardized 1-NN, Section 3.8 ).
They differ only in which descriptor parameters are learned, except that Mixer+Q starts its quantization at 128 levels instead of 256: • Fixed learns no descriptor parameter: it keeps the initial radii, the uniform angles, the zero thresholds and M b ( 0 ) M_{b}^{(0)} , trains only the class proxies and is the no-learning reference; • Color learns the color transforms M b M_{b} only; • Radius learns the four basis radii only; • Threshold learns the thresholds ω b , k \omega_{b,k} only; • Geometry learns the radii, angles and thresholds jointly, with M b M_{b} and L b L_{b} frozen; • Mixer+Q learns the color transforms M b M_{b} , which mix the channels, and the numbers of quantization levels L b L_{b} jointly, with the radii, angles and thresholds frozen; • All joint , the fully learned descriptor, learns the color transforms, radii, angles and thresholds jointly, with the quantization frozen. Training lasts 8 to 20 epochs depending on the dataset, and we select the checkpoint by validation 1-NN accuracy on a 15% stratified holdout of the training partition.
On KTH-TIPS2, an inner leave-one-sample-out validation chooses the number of epochs instead (Supplementary Section S1).
The test partition is never used for checkpoint selection.

blocks.en: 4.3 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 4.3 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
All images are resized to 128 × 128 128{\times}128 pixels.
The radius bounds and initial radii follow the ordered fine/mid/coarse scheme of Section 3.5 in two templates (Supplementary Section S4 lists the exact bounds).
The compact one serves NewBarkTex and Parquet (initial radii of 2.0, 5.0 and 8.0 pixels), and the wide one the other benchmarks (2.0, 6.0 and 10.0 pixels).
Within a dataset, every configuration shares the same template.
The templates were set during development, when the test accuracies of earlier runs were visible, and not by a held-out selection procedure, so Supplementary Section S16 swaps them on every benchmark.
blocks.zh:
所有图像的大小都调整为128×128 128\times}128像素.
半径界限和初始弧度遵循第3.5节所订购的细/中/粗方案,分为两个模板(补充部分S4列出了确切界限)。
紧凑的一款服务于NewBarkTex和Parquet(初始半径为2.0,5.0和8.0像素),而宽的一款则服务于其他基准(2.0,6.0和10.0像素).
在数据集内,每个配置共享同一个模板.
模板是在开发期间设定的,在早期运行的测试精度可见时,而不是通过搁置选择程序设定的,因此补充部分S16在每个基准上互换.

blocks.en:
We use Adam with component-specific learning rates: 2 × 10 − 3 2{\times}10^{-3} for radii; 10 − 3 10^{-3} for color transforms, angles and class proxies; and 5 × 10 − 4 5{\times}10^{-4} for thresholds and quantization.
Weight decay is 10 − 4 10^{-4} , except on radii, angles, thresholds and quantization, and a step schedule halves all rates once.
The batch size is 4 on NewBarkTex and Parquet and 8 elsewhere.
The loss of Eq. ( 13 ) uses s = 20 s{=}20 , ξ = 0.1 \xi{=}0.1 , λ geom = 0.01 \lambda_{\mathrm{geom}}{=}0.01 and λ ω = 0.001 \lambda_{\omega}{=}0.001 .
The pair ( s , ξ ) (s,\xi) is the best setting of a sweep over both, across which raw 1-NN accuracy varies by about 1.5 pp (Supplementary Section S2).
There is no data augmentation, and image borders are reflect-padded.
An NCA objective is at best on par with the proxy loss (Supplementary Section S3).

Section 4.10 reports the extraction times of our unoptimized PyTorch implementation.
Training one configuration takes 3–20 minutes on a laptop GPU (NVIDIA RTX 2000 Ada), and up to 50 minutes on KTH-TIPS2, whose protocol adds an inner cross-validation.
blocks.zh:
第4.10节报告了我们未优化的PyTorch执行的提取时间。
训练一种配置在笔记本电脑GPU(NVIDIA RTX 2000 Ada)上需要3–20分钟,在KTH-TIPS2上需要50分钟,其协议增加了内置交叉验证.

blocks.en:
Geometry learning (radii, angles and thresholds) is best on TC31 and TC13, and joint optimization is best on NewBarkTex, Parquet and USPtex.
On the photometric suites TC32 and TC34, threshold learning alone is best.
Because TC31, TC32 and TC34 share their training images, their different winners show that the best configuration depends on the test-time shift and not only on the training data.
Radius learning alone improves six of the eight benchmarks, by at most 2.50 pp (TC13).
blocks.zh:
几何学习(radi,角度和阈值)在TC31和TC13上最好,联合优化在NewBarkTex,Parquet和USPtex上最好.
在TC32和TC34的测光套房上,单是阈值学习是最好的.
因为TC31,TC32和TC34分享了他们的训练画面,所以他们不同的获奖者显示最佳配置取决于测试时间的转变,而不仅仅是训练数据.
单是半径学习就改进了8个基准中的6个,最多2.50pp(TC13).

blocks.en:
The color transform learned alone improves five of the eight benchmarks but is never the best configuration, and it degrades KTH-TIPS2, TC13 and TC34 (by 7.83 pp on TC34).
Mixer+Q is even less reliable: it falls below Fixed on six of the eight benchmarks.
Part of this loss may come from its coarser starting quantization, which this ablation does not separate from learning.
blocks.zh:
单独学来的色彩变换改进了8个基准中的5个,但从未是最佳的配置,它降解了KTH-TIPS2,TC13和TC34(在TC34上的7.83页).
Mixer QQ更不可靠:它低于八项基准中的六项。
这一损失的一部分可能来自它的粗体开始量化,这种衰减与学习并不分离.

blocks.en:
We also test a sequential schedule that learns the geometry first and the color transform second, and ends with a short joint fine-tuning phase.
It checks whether such a curriculum avoids the failures of joint optimization (Section 5.3 ).
After full postprocessing, it underperforms the best single-pass configuration on every dataset, by 0.6 pp (NewBarkTex, USPtex) to 9.7 pp (Parquet), so single-pass training remains the default.
blocks.zh:
我们还测试一个学习几何第一和颜色变换第二的顺序表,最后是短的联合微调阶段.
它检查这种课程是否避免了联合优化的失败(第5.3节)。
在全程后处理后,它表现不佳,每个数据集上最好的单行道配置,以0.6pp(NewBarkTex,USPtex)到9.7pp(Parquet),所以单行道训练仍然是默认.

LBP r ​ i ​ u ​ 2 \mathrm{LBP}^{riu2} : the classical reference of Table 2 , read out by 1-NN. Mean: over the six main benchmarks; its Sig. cells sum the rows above. Bold : best of each readout in each row, the Oracle excepted.
blocks.zh: 表3:后处理后的端到端准确度(%)(PP:统一-u2预测和电源正常化). 描述符通过标准化的1-NN,本文的协议,以及收缩的LDA来读出. 值表示±\pm标准差于训练种子:五为几何(42-46),三为全关节(42-44),五为固定,五为几何种子的颜色初始化. 西格:所学的描述符明显优于/劣于同一种子的固定描述符,读音相同(精确的McNemar测试,p < 0.05 p{<}0.05). 甲骨文(Oracle):在后处理(种子42)之后的表2六个学习到的配置中最优秀的,在测试分拆上选择,因此是上限. LBP r i i i 2\mathrm{LBP}^{riu2} : 表2的经典参考文献,按1-NN读出。 平均值:超过六个主要基准;其Sig.单元格将上行相加。 粗体:每行中每个读数最好,甲骨文除外.

blocks.en:
On the six main benchmarks, postprocessing adds + 2.02 +2.02 pp on average to the Fixed descriptor (seed 42), and learning the geometry adds + 3.55 +3.55 pp on top of it (five seeds).
On TC31 and TC32, uniform-u2 projection alone lifts the Fixed descriptor by + 5.74 +5.74 and + 17.20 +17.20 pp (seed 42), more than learning gains on the raw descriptor ( + 4.41 +4.41 pp with Geometry and + 6.76 +6.76 pp with Threshold).
The learning gain nevertheless survives postprocessing and is sometimes amplified by it.
On TC32 and KTH-TIPS2, Geometry gains + 5.66 +5.66 and + 0.50 +0.50 pp over Fixed before postprocessing (seed 42) and + 8.40 +8.40 and + 6.71 +6.71 pp after it (paired over five seeds).
Postprocessing does not always help: u2 projection slightly lowers TC13 for both the Fixed and learned descriptors (seed 42), so the non-uniform codes that it pools sometimes carry discriminative information.
blocks.zh:
在六大基准上,后处理平均在固定描述符(种子42)中增加+2.02+2.02页,学习几何在上加+3.55+3.55页(种子五种).
在TC31和TC32上,单是统一-u2投影就可以将固定描述符提升到+5.74+5.74和+17.20+17.20pp(种子42),超过原始描述符的学习收益(+4.41+4.41pp,带有几何,+6.76+6.76pp,带有阈值).
尽管如此,学习收益仍然在后处理中存活下来,有时也会因此而扩大。
在TC32和KTH-TIPS2上,几何增益+5.66+5.66和+0.50+0.50页在后处理前固定(种子42),并在后加8.40+8.40和+6.71+6.71页(在5个种子上标注).
后处理并不总是有帮助的:u2投影对固定和学习的描述符(种子42)都略低了TC13,所以它集合起来的非统一代码有时会携带歧视性信息.

blocks.en:
Backbone-based and randomized-network pipelines such as RADAM [ Scabini et al., 2023 ] and that of Ribas et al. [2024] classify with LDA or a linear support vector machine (SVM).
For comparability, the LDA columns of Table 3 add a shrinkage LDA on the same postprocessed descriptors.
On NewBarkTex, TC13, Parquet and USPtex, LDA is clearly stronger than 1-NN for all three descriptors.
Under LDA, the learning gain shrinks: Geometry is above its paired Fixed descriptor on five of the six main benchmarks, by + 0.92 +0.92 pp on average.
The gain is significant in only 6 of the 30 tests, and Geometry is below Fixed on TC13 ( − 0.65 -0.65 pp, significantly in one seed).
All joint keeps more of its gain: over its three seeds, it is above its paired Fixed descriptor on all six main benchmarks, by + 2.68 +2.68 pp on average.
Its gain is significant in 10 of the 18 tests, with no significant loss.
On KTH-TIPS2 and on the suites with a controlled train/test change, LDA brings Fixed and Geometry little or no gain and can cost several points.
With LDA, All joint falls below its paired Fixed descriptor under the photometric shifts (TC32 − 7.87 -7.87 pp, TC34 − 4.63 -4.63 pp).
blocks.zh:
基于背骨的和随机的网络管道,如RADAM[Scabini等人,2023年]和Ribas等人的管道。 [2024] 与LDA或线性支持矢量机(SVM)进行分类.
关于可比性,表3的LDA列在同一经过处理的描述符上增加了缩写LDA.
在NewBarkTex,TC13,Parquet和USPtex上,LDA显然比1-NN更强,适用于所有三个描述符.
在LDA下,学习增益收缩: 几何在六大基准中的五个上高于其配对的固定描述符,平均比0.92+0.92 pp.
在30个测试中,只有6个测试中收获显著,在TC13上几何学低于固定(−0.65-0.65pp,一个种子中显著).
所有关节都保存着更多的收益:在它的三颗种子上,在所有六个主要基准上,它都高于其配对的固定描述符,平均为+2.68+2.68页.
在18项试验中,有10项试验取得了显著收益,没有重大损失。
在KTH-TIPS2上和带有可控列车/测试变化的套房上,LDA带来的固定和几何收益很少或没有,可以花费几分.
与LDA, 在光度变化下,所有关节都低于其成对的固定标注(TC32 - 7.87 - 7.87 pp,TC34 - 4.63 - 4.63 pp)。

blocks.en: 4.6 Training seeds and statistical significance
blocks.zh: 4.6 培训种子和统计意义

blocks.en:
Each texture benchmark has a single test split, so we compare two models by the exact McNemar test on their predictions for the same test images.
It accounts for the finite test sample, not for training randomness, which we measure over seeds.
The paragraphs below use the 1-NN columns of Table 3 ; Section 4.5 discusses the LDA columns.
blocks.zh:
每个纹理基准都有一个单一的测试分裂,所以我们用精确的麦克尼玛测试来比较两个模型对相同的测试图像的预测.
它代表了有限的测试样本,而不是训练的随机性, 我们用种子来衡量。
以下段落使用表3的1-NN栏;第4.5节讨论LDA栏。

blocks.en:
Over five seeds, Geometry is more accurate than the paired Fixed descriptor on all six main benchmarks, by + 3.55 +3.55 pp on average (Table 3 ).
The gain is significant in 22 of the 30 seed-level tests, and 17 of these survive a Bonferroni correction ( p < 0.0017 p{<}0.0017 ).
On NewBarkTex, the gain vanishes ( + 0.12 +0.12 pp, significant in no seed), and no seed is significantly worse than its Fixed descriptor on any main benchmark.
Single-seed results overstate the gain: after postprocessing, the seed-42 run of Table 2 is the best or second best of the five on seven of the eight benchmarks.
On the illuminant suite TC34, Geometry gains only + 1.29 +1.29 pp, with two seeds significantly better and one significantly worse (Supplementary Section S13).
blocks.zh:
5个以上的种子,几何学在所有6个主要基准上比配对的固定描述符更准确,平均比+3.55+3.55pp(表3).
在30个种子级测试中的22个测试中,收益显著,其中17个在Bonferroni校正后存活(p < 0.007 p{<}0.0017)。
在NewBarkTex上,增益消失(+0.12+0.12pp,在无种子中显著),没有种子比它在任何主要基准上的固定描述值要糟糕得多.
单一种子结果夸大了收益:在后处理后,表2的种子-42是8个基准中7个基准中5个的最好或第二好。
在光辉的套房TC34上,几何学只获得+1.29+1.29pp,有两种种子显著优异,一种种子明显差(补充部分S13).

blocks.en:
All joint gains slightly more on average ( + 3.69 +3.69 pp over the six main benchmarks), but less reliably.
It dominates on Parquet ( + 15.50 +15.50 pp, significant in all three seeds).
It is, however, significantly worse than the Fixed descriptor in all three seeds on KTH-TIPS2 ( − 2.56 -2.56 pp) and TC34 ( − 5.68 -5.68 pp).
Of its 18 tests on the main benchmarks, 13 are significant gains and 3 significant losses, against 22 gains and no loss in the 30 tests of Geometry.
blocks.zh:
所有共同收益平均略高(比六个主要基准增加3.69+3.69页),但可靠性较低。
它在Parquet上占据主导地位(+15.50+15.50 pp,在所有三种种子中都显著).
然而,在KTH-TIPS2(−2.56-2.56pp)和TC34(−5.68-5.68pp)上的所有三个种子中,它都比固定描述器严重得多.
在对主要基准的18项测试中,有13项是重大收益,3项是重大损失,而在对几何的30项测试中,有22项是重大收益,没有损失。

blocks.en:
The oracle results of Tables 2 and 3 use the configuration that scores best on each test split, so they are optimistic.
Choosing the configuration per dataset by validation 1-NN does not solve this, because the holdouts are too small or too close to the training distribution to rank the configurations.
TC31, TC32 and TC34 share one training partition and therefore have nearly identical validation scores, while their test accuracies differ by more than 50 pp.
The validation-selected configurations (seed 42) even lose significantly to Fixed on KTH-TIPS2 ( − 2.28 -2.28 pp) and TC13 ( − 2.94 -2.94 pp).
The robust choice is to apply one configuration, Geometry, unchanged to every benchmark, and we recommend it.
This choice was informed by the seed-42 results of Table 2 , so those results are not an independent test of it.
The four additional seeds and Kather-CRC were run after the choice was made and are such a test.
Over seeds, Geometry keeps its gains, and on Kather-CRC it significantly improves the Fixed descriptor (Section 4.9 ).
Color learning is the fragile ingredient: for seed 42, every configuration that learns the color transform loses significantly to Fixed on at least two benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
表2和表3的甲骨文结果使用在每个测试分数上得分最好的配置,因此它们乐观.
通过验证 1-NN 选择每个数据集的配置并不能解决这个问题,因为阻力太小或太靠近训练分布,无法对配置进行排序.
TC31,TC32和TC34共用一个训练分区,因此其验证分数几乎相同,而他们的测试速率则相差超过50pp.
验证-选定的配置(种子42)甚至被KTH-TIPS2(−2.28-2.28 pp)和TC13(−2.94-2.94 pp)上的固定型(固定型)大幅损失.
有力的选择是应用一个配置,几何,每个基准不变,我们推荐它.
这一选择从表2的种子-42结果中得知,因此这些结果不是对它的独立测试.
附加的4种种子和Kather-CRC是在做出选择后运行的,是这样的测试.
在种子上,几何保持其收益,在Kather-CRC上,它大大改进了固定描述符(第4.9节)。
颜色学习是脆弱的成分:对于种子42,每一个学习颜色变换的配置,在至少两个基准上都明显输给固定.

blocks.en:
The adjacent-bin estimator of Eq. ( 12 ) trains better than the bit-aware alternative of Section 3.6 on seven of the eight benchmarks, significantly on three (seed 42).
Among the temperatures τ = 3 \tau{=}3 , 10 and 30, none is best on all four benchmarks tested.
Swapping the radius templates changes Geometry by − 3.16 -3.16 to + 4.39 +4.39 pp but keeps its gain over the same-template Fixed descriptor positive on all eight benchmarks, significantly on five (Supplementary Section S16).
With the other template, Geometry is significantly less accurate on KTH-TIPS2 ( − 3.03 -3.03 pp) and TC32 ( − 3.16 -3.16 pp).
Both use the wide template, which was introduced for KTH-TIPS2, so this choice may have benefited from test-set information there.
blocks.zh:
Eq.(12)列车的相邻-宾估计器优于第3.6节在8个基准中的7个基准的位元认知替代,显著的3个(种子42).
在温度 = 3\tau 3, 10和 30 中, 4 个基准测试均无最佳效果。
将半径模板切换成− 3.16 - 3.16 到 + 4.39 + 4.39 pp,但在所有8个基准上,在5个基准(补充部分S16)上,它相对于同一模板的固定描述符的增益保持正数。
与其他模板一起,几何学在KTH-TIPS2(− 3.03-3.03 pp)和TC32(− 3.16-3.16 pp)上的准确度明显较低.
两者都使用宽模板,为KTH-TIPS2引入,因此这一选择可能得益于那里的测试集信息.

blocks.en: 4.7 Comparison within the LBP family
blocks.zh: 4.7 不丹不丹王国家庭内部的比较

blocks.en:
Table 4 compares FLEX-LBP with classical and learned members of the LBP family, all rerun under our protocol: the same splits, the same 128 × 128 128{\times}128 inputs and the same test images.
The classical descriptors are the anchor LBP r ​ i ​ u ​ 2 \mathrm{LBP}^{riu2} , the joint CLBP_S/M/C histogram [ Guo et al., 2010a ] , LTP [ Tan and Triggs, 2010 ] , MRELBP [ Liu et al., 2016 ] and BSIF [ Kannala and Rahtu, 2012 ] , with the default parameters of their papers and nothing tuned on our data.
NLBP [ Peeples et al., 2026 ] is trained with the authors’ public code and recipe.
PCANet [ Chan et al., 2015 ] follows the texture setting of its paper, with filters learned without labels on each training split (Supplementary Section S11 details every baseline).
Two fixed variants of our pipeline, both with the identity color transform, complete the table.
Sign-only keeps only the sign codes, which makes it an OCLBP-style descriptor [ Mäenpää and
Pietikäinen, 2004 ] at our three scales, with both orderings of each inter-channel pair, our sampling radii and our postprocessing.
LTP coding replaces the sign and magnitude codes by the upper and lower codes of LTP, with a dead zone of ± 0.05 \pm 0.05 on intensities in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] .
blocks.zh:
表4将FLEX-LBP与LBP家族的古典和有学识的成员进行比较,这些成员都根据我们的协议重新运行:相同的拆分,相同的128×128128×时 128输入和相同的测试图像.
古典描述符是主播LBP r i u i mathrm{LBP}^{riu2},联合CLBP_S/M/C直方图 [Guo et al., 2010a], LTP [Tan and Triggs, 2010], MRELBP [Liu et al., 2016] 和 BSIF [Kannala and Rahtu, 2012], 其论文的默认参数和我们的数据上没有任何调值.
NLPP[Peples等人,2026年]接受了关于提交人公共代码和食谱的培训。
PCANet[Chan等人,2015年]遵循其纸张的纹理设置,在每次培训分拆时都学会没有标签的过滤器(补充部分S11详细列出每个基线)。
我们输油管的两个固定变体, 两者的身份颜色变换, 完成表。
只有签名才保留签名代码,这使得它成为OCLBP风格的描述符[Mäenpää和
Pietikäinen,2004年),在我们三个尺度上,每对通道间对的订单,我们的取样光度和我们的后处理.
LTP编码以LTP的上下码取代标志和尺寸码,在强度上以±0.05\pm 0.05的死区表示[0,1] [0,1].

blocks.en: Table 4: Comparison within the LBP family on the six main benchmarks: accuracy (%). Our pipeline: postprocessed standardized 1-NN. Classical descriptors: best of four variants (gray or RGB input, χ 2 \chi^{2} or standardized 1-NN), chosen on the test split, which favors them; c : the RGB variant is the best one. NLBP: best of its own classifier and 1-NN on its features, local or global aggregation. PCANet: best of twelve variants (gray or RGB input, block or global histograms, χ 2 \chi^{2} 1-NN, standardized 1-NN or linear SVM). Sign-only, LTP coding and Fixed: our three-branch, nine-pair color pipeline with fixed parameters and three different codes. Sign-only and LTP coding use the identity color transform, and Fixed is the mean over its five color initializations. Geometry and All joint: means over five and three seeds. ▲ / △ : significantly more accurate than the strongest entry of the column that is not learned FLEX-LBP (classical, PCANet, NLBP or our fixed pipeline) in all/some seeds (exact McNemar test, p < 0.05 p{<}0.05 ). Bold : best of each column. NBT: NewBarkTex; KTH: KTH-TIPS2; PAQ: Parquet; USP: USPtex.
blocks.zh: 表4:地方植物计划家庭内部对六个主要基准的比较:准确性(%)。 我们的管道:经过处理后的1NN标准化. 古典描述符:最好的四个变体(gray或RGB输入,QQ 2\chi^{2}或标准化的1-NN),选在测试拆分上,这有利于它们;c:RGB变体是最佳的. NLPP: 最佳自身分类器和1-NN关于其特征,局部或全球汇总. PCANet:最佳十二种变体(Gray或RGB输入,块或全局直方图,χ2\chi^{2}1-NN,标准化1-NN或线性SVM). 只有符号,LTP编码和固定:我们的三分支,九帕彩色管道有固定参数和三个不同的代码. 只签名和LTP编码使用身份色彩变换,而固定是其五色初始化的平均值. 几何和所有联合:指超过5个和3个种子. ▲ / △ :比没有学过FLEX-LBP(古典、PCAPNet、NLPP或我们的固定管道)的栏目在全部/某些种子中最强的条目要准确得多(精确的McNemar测试,p < 0.05 p{<}0.05)。 粗体:每列最优秀. NBT: NewBarkTex; KTH: KTH- TIPS2; PAQ: Parquet; USP: USPtex.

blocks.en:
Against the external descriptors, FLEX-LBP is the most accurate on five of the six main benchmarks (Table 4 ).
Geometry is significantly more accurate than the strongest classical descriptor in all five seeds on KTH-TIPS2 (MRELBP), TC13 (CLBP) and TC31 (BSIF), and in four seeds on USPtex (CLBP).
On NewBarkTex, it is 2.9 pp ahead of BSIF, but significantly so in one seed only.
On Parquet, CLBP on RGB is ahead of Geometry, significantly in two seeds, and level with All joint.
Among the learned descriptors, PCANet is ahead of NLBP on average but below Geometry on all six benchmarks.
Geometry leads it significantly in all five seeds on KTH-TIPS2, TC13 and TC31, in two on USPtex and in one on NewBarkTex, with a tie on Parquet.
NLBP stays far below on every benchmark, and Geometry beats it in all five seeds on all six benchmarks.
Averaged over the six benchmarks, Geometry reaches 83.10%, against 78.51% for the best classical descriptor (CLBP), 78.46% for PCANet and 62.76% for NLBP.
blocks.zh:
对照外部描述,FLEX-LBP在六个主要基准中的五个基准中最为准确(表4)。
几何学在KTH-TIPS2(MRELBP)、TC13(CLBP)和TC31(BSIF)上的所有五个种子中,以及USPtex(CLBP)上的四个种子中,都比最强的古典描述法要精确得多。
在NewBarkTex上,它比BSIF领先2.9pp,但在一个种子中却明显如此.
在Parquet上,RGB上的CLBP领先于几何,在两个种子中显著,与All coup一起处于水平.
在所学的描述词中,PAPNet在所有六项基准上平均高于无法律约束力文书,但低于几何标准。
几何在KTH-TIPS2,TC13和TC31上的所有5个种子中都显著领先,在USPtex上为2个,在NewBarkTex上为1个,在Parquet上为平局.
在每一个基准上,NLAP都远远低于标准,在所有六个基准上,几何在所有五个种子中都比它高。
在六个基准中,几何平均达到83.10%,最佳古典描述词(CLBP)为78.51%,PCAPNet为78.46%,NBP为62.76%。

blocks.en:
To check whether the ranking depends on the 1-NN readout of the classical descriptors, we apply the shrinkage LDA of Section 3.8 to every descriptor (Supplementary Section S22).
Within the LBP family, FLEX-LBP is again the most accurate on five of the six benchmarks, but not the same five.
On NewBarkTex, TC13, TC31, Parquet and USPtex, even Fixed stays above the strongest classical descriptor and PCANet.
Geometry is significantly ahead of the strongest classical descriptor in all five seeds on four of these benchmarks and in two seeds on Parquet.
All joint is significantly ahead in all three seeds on all five.
KTH-TIPS2 is the exception: MRELBP reaches 86.76%, significantly above Geometry (76.24%) and All joint (76.95%) in every seed, which reverses the 1-NN result of Geometry.
blocks.zh:
为了检查排名是否取决于古典描述词的1-NN读出,我们将3.8节的缩水LDA应用于每个描述词(补充部分S22).
在LBP家族中,FLEX-LBP在6个基准中的5个基准上再次是最准确的,但不是相同的5个基准.
在NewBarkTex,TC13,TC31,Parquet和USPtex上,甚至固定停留在最强的古典描述符和CPANet之上.
在其中4个基准上的所有5个种子和Parquet上的2个种子中,几何明显领先于最强的古典描述.
所有联赛在全部5个种子上都有显著领先.
KTH-TIPS2是例外:MRELBP达到86.76%,显著高于几何学(76.24%),每个种子的全关节(76.95%),这逆转了几何学的1-NN结果.

blocks.en:
Within our own pipeline, the coding matters as much as learning.
With fixed LTP codes in place of the sign and magnitude codes, the pipeline reaches the same mean accuracy as Geometry (83.22% against 83.10%).
LTP coding is ahead on TC13, TC31 and Parquet, significantly in two and three of the five seeds on TC31 and Parquet.
It is behind on NewBarkTex, KTH-TIPS2 and USPtex, significantly in all five seeds on the first two and in three on USPtex.
blocks.zh:
在我们自己的管道里 编码和学习一样重要
由于固定的LTP代码代替了标志和尺寸代码,管道达到了与几何相同的平均精度(83.22%对83.10%).
LTP编码在TC13,TC31和Parquet上领先,在TC31和Parquet上的5个种子中有2个和3个显著.
它在NewBarkTex,KTH-TIPS2和USPtex上落后,在前两个和USPtex上所有五个种子中都有显著的出现.

blocks.en:
The gap between LTP coding and our sign-plus-magnitude coding lies mainly in the type of magnitude threshold (Supplementary Section S17).
Our magnitude code compares each magnitude with the mean magnitude of the same image (Section 3.3 ), which discards the absolute size of the differences that the absolute dead zone of LTP keeps.
On TC31 and Parquet, this size is itself a strong class cue.
Used alone, the 27 per-image mean magnitudes μ b ( i , j ) \mu_{b}^{(i,j)} of the Fixed descriptor reach 87.57% on TC31 and 74.56% on Parquet, more on Parquet than any descriptor of Table 4 .
With an absolute magnitude threshold equal to the dead zone of LTP coding ( m > 0.05 m{>}0.05 ), the Fixed descriptor with the identity color transform rises from 79.42% to 83.20% on average.
It thus reaches the level of LTP coding and closes most of the gap to it on TC13, TC31 and Parquet.
Conversely, with a dead zone set to the mean magnitude of each image, LTP coding loses most of its lead (Parquet 47.37% instead of 64.04%).
Restricting the descriptor to one kind of channel pair shows that on Parquet and TC13, the gain of the absolute threshold comes from the inter-channel pairs (Supplementary Table S18).
Their magnitudes include the difference between two channels, that is, color.
For the whole descriptor, the absolute threshold loses accuracy on NewBarkTex and under the illuminant change of TC34, so neither type of threshold is best on every benchmark.
blocks.zh:
LTP编码与我们的标志加宽编码之间的差距主要在于星级阈值的类型(补充部分S17).
我们的星等代码将每个星等与同一图像的平均值(第3.3节)进行比较,它放弃了LTP绝对死区所保持的绝对差异的绝对大小.
在TC31和Parquet上,这个尺寸本身就是一个强烈的类提示.
单是使用,固定描述符的27个每幅图像平均值为μb(i, j)\mu_{b}^{(i, j)}在TC31上达到87.57%,在Parquet上达到74.56%,在Parquet上超过表4的任何描述符.
其绝对星等阈值等于LTP编码的死区(m > 0.05 m{>}0.05),具有身份颜色的固定描述符平均从79.42%升至83.20%.
因此它达到了LTP编码的水平,并关闭了TC13,TC31和Parquet上的大部分缺口.
反之,随着一个死区设定到每个图像的平均值,LTP编码失去了大部分铅(Parquet 47.37%而不是64.04%).
将描述符限制为一种通道对表示,在Parquet和TC13上,绝对阈值的增益来自通道间对(补充表S18).
它们的规模包括两个渠道的区别,即颜色.
对于整个描述器,绝对阈值在NewBarkTex上和TC34的光辉变化下失去准确性,所以这两种阈值在每一个基准上都不是最好的.

blocks.en: 4.8 Photometric shifts: noise and illuminant
blocks.zh: 4.8 测光变化:噪音和照明剂

blocks.en:
On the two photometric suites, the color descriptor is far behind the best descriptors, PCANet and BSIF (Table 5 ).
To locate the failure, we pair every test image with its training twin, the same crop acquired under the training conditions.
We then dissect the Fixed descriptor by branch and by channel pair (Supplementary Section S12).
blocks.zh:
在两个测光套房上,彩色描述符远远落后于最佳描述符PAPNet和BSIF(表5).
为了找到故障,我们把每个测试图像配以训练双胞胎,也就是在训练条件下获得的相同作物。
然后,我们按分支和频道对子(补充部分S12)对固定文字进行解析。

blocks.en: Table 5: Photometric shift suites: postprocessed standardized 1-NN accuracy (%). Classical descriptors, PCANet and NLBP as in Table 4 (best variant on the test split; c : RGB). Fixed with RGB input: the single run to which the remedies below are applied. Geometry with RGB input: mean ± \pm SD over five seeds. The remedies are applied at inference, without retraining, to the Fixed descriptor and to the trained Geometry model (seed 42). Δ main \Delta_{\mathrm{main}} : the mean accuracy change that the remedy causes for the Fixed descriptor on the six main benchmarks (Supplementary Section S12). The remedies were chosen by diagnosing these two suites, so they are not held-out results. Bold : best of each accuracy column.
blocks.zh: 表5:测光班套房:经过处理后标准化的1-NN精度(%). 如表4(试验分拆的最佳变体;c:RGB)所示,经典描述符、PAPNet和NLPP。 用 RGB 输入固定: 应用以下补救方法的单运行 。 有RGB输入的几何:表示±\pm SD超过5个种子. 补救措施在不进行再培训的情况下,在推论中适用于固定描述符和受过训练的几何模型(种子42)。 主 \ Delta\ mathrm{ main} : 在六个主要基准(补充部分S12)中,补救方法给固定描述者造成的平均准确性变化。 治疗方法是通过诊断这两个套房来选择的,因此它们没有被搁置的结果. 粗体:每个精度列中最优.

blocks.en:
In TC32, the added noise has an SD of 5.1 gray levels per channel.
This is larger than the typical contrast between neighboring pixels of the clean images (a mean absolute difference of 4.3 gray levels), so many single-pixel comparisons become random.
The fine branch suffers most, and the intra-channel pairs (54.56%) more than the inter-channel pairs (75.29%), whose differences between channels are often larger than the noise.
Learned thresholds help, as an offset that ignores small differences should, but averaging before comparing helps much more.
Sampling each neighbor and the center as the median of a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 patch, the regional sampling of MRELBP, raises the Fixed descriptor to 96.10%.
A 3 × 3 3{\times}3 median-filtered input raises it to 95.07%.
blocks.zh:
在TC32中,添加的噪声每个通道的SD为5.1灰度.
这比清洁图像的相邻像素(平均绝对差4.3灰度)之间的典型对比要大,因此许多单像素比较变得随机.
细枝节受影响最大,通道内对数(54.56%)大于通道间对数(75.29%),其渠道间差异往往大于噪音.
学到的阈值会有所帮助,因为这种抵消应忽略小的差别,但在比较之前平均会大有帮助。
将每个邻居和中心取样为3×3 3×3}3补丁的中位数,MRELBP的区域取样,将固定描述器提高到96.10%.
3 × 3 3 × 3 × 3 × 3 中度过滤输入法将其提高到95.07%.

blocks.en:
In TC34, an affine fit between each test image and its training twin shows that the illuminant scales the three channels by different gains (Supplementary Section S12).
Comparisons within one channel are invariant to such a gain, but comparisons between channels are not.
On its intra-channel pairs alone, the Fixed descriptor reaches 79.12%, on its inter-channel pairs alone 21.36% and on a luminance input 93.38%.
Learned thresholds also break the gain invariance of the intra-channel sign codes (40.66% with Geometry against 77.79% for Fixed, seed 42).
Normalizing each channel by its image mean, the gray-world assumption [ Buchsbaum, 1980 ] , cancels per-channel gains and raises the Fixed descriptor to 96.99%.
This agrees with Mäenpää and
Pietikäinen [2004] : under the same test illuminants (Outex TC14), opponent color texture descriptors were hit especially hard, and a comprehensive color normalization helped considerably.
blocks.zh:
在TC34中,每个测试图像和它的训练双胞胎之间搭配的亲缘关系表明,光亮度通过不同的增益(补充部分S12)对三个通道进行比对.
一个频道内部的比较对于这种收益是无与伦比的,但各频道之间的比较却并非如此。
仅在其内通道对数上,固定标注值就达到79.12%,其间通道对数单是21.36%,其亮度输入率为93.38%。
学到的阈值也打破了通道内标志码的变动率(40.66%,固定种子42的几何学为77.79%)。
每个频道按其形象规范化意味着灰色世界假设[Buchsbaum,1980年],取消每个频道的收益,并将固定描述值提高到96.99%.
这与Mäenp 一致,
Pietikäinen [2004]:在同一个测试灯光剂(Outex TC14)下,对手的颜色纹理描述符受到特别重的打击,全面的色彩正常化大有帮助.

blocks.en:
Each remedy fixes its own nuisance and can hurt elsewhere (Table 5 ; Supplementary Section S12 reports its cost on every benchmark).
On the six main benchmarks, the median support costs most on Parquet ( − 7.01 -7.01 pp), where fine wood grain separates the classes.
Luminance input costs 12.2 pp on average, which measures what color contributes on these benchmarks.
Gray-world input combined with the median support handles both suites at an average cost of 0.76 pp on the main benchmarks.
With its remedy, the Fixed descriptor is statistically tied with BSIF on TC34 (96.99% against 97.61%, p = 0.12 p{=}0.12 ) and slightly behind it on TC32 (96.10% against 97.72%, p = 0.02 p{=}0.02 ).
PCANet stays significantly ahead of the remedied Fixed descriptor on both suites ( p < 10 − 3 p{<}10^{-3} ).
blocks.zh:
每一种补救办法都解决自身的麻烦,并可能在别处造成伤害(表5;补充部分S12按每个基准报告其成本)。
在6个主要基准上,Parquet(-7.01-7.01页)的中位支持费用最多,因为那里有细木质的谷物将各阶层分开。
光度输入平均成本为12.2页,衡量颜色对这些基准的贡献。
Gray-world输入与中位支持手柄相结合,在主要基准上两个套件平均成本为0.76pp.
固定描述符在TC34上与BSIF(96.99%对97.61%,p=0.12p=0.12p=0.12)有统计联系,在TC32上略落后(96.10%对97.72%,p=0.02p=0.02)。
常设仲裁法院网络大大领先于两个套房的补救性固定描述符(p < 10 - 3 p{<}10^{-3})。

blocks.en:
Plugged into the trained Geometry model at inference, without retraining, the median remedies keep the learning gain on TC32 (Table 5 ).
With the median support and the median-filtered input, Geometry is significantly above the Fixed descriptor with the same remedy ( p = 0.005 p{=}0.005 and p < 10 − 9 p{<}10^{-9} ) and statistically tied with BSIF ( p = 0.71 p{=}0.71 and 0.59 0.59 ).
With the median-filtered input, it is also statistically tied with PCANet ( p = 0.42 p{=}0.42 ).
The per-channel normalization does not keep it: on TC34, Geometry with gray-world input reaches 92.21%, below the Fixed descriptor with the same input (96.99%), because its thresholds were learned on unnormalized intensities.
blocks.zh:
在不进行再培训的情况下,中位补救法将学习收益保留在TC32上(表5)。
由于中位支持和中位过滤输入,几何学明显高于固定描述符,具有相同的补救方法(p=0.005 p{=}0.005和p < 10−9 p{<}10^{-9}),统计学上与BSIF绑定(p=0.71 p{=}0.71和0.59 0.59).
用中位过滤输入,它也从统计上与PAPCNet(p=0.42 p{=}0.42)捆绑在一起.
每通道的正常化并不能保持它:在TC34上,带有灰色世界输入的几何学达到92.21%,低于具有相同输入的固定描述符(96.99%),因为其阈值是在非正常强度上学习的.

blocks.en: 4.9 Application to colorectal cancer histology
blocks.zh: 4.9 子宫颈癌组织学的应用

blocks.en:
On Kather-CRC, we run Fixed, Geometry and All joint with the USPtex configuration and one training run per fold, and the other descriptors exactly as in Section 4.7 (Supplementary Section S15).
Table 6 reports the results over the five folds, and the McNemar tests below pool their predictions (5,000 test tiles).
blocks.zh:
在Kather-CRC上,我们与USPtex配置进行固定、几何和所有联合操作,每叠一次训练,其他描述与第4.7节(补充部分S15)完全相同。
表6汇报了五叠叠的结果,麦克尼马尔测试在下方汇集了他们的预测(5,000个测试瓦).

blocks.en: Table 6: Kather-CRC colorectal cancer histology (eight tissue classes, stratified five-fold cross-validation): accuracy (%), mean ± \pm standard deviation over folds. Classical descriptors, PCANet and NLBP as in Table 4 (classical: best of χ 2 \chi^{2} and standardized 1-NN; c : RGB input). FLEX-LBP descriptors after postprocessing, one training run per fold. LDA: the shrinkage LDA of Section 3.8 on every descriptor, with the same input as its 1-NN variant; PCANet: its best variant in each column (1-NN column: linear SVM on RGB block histograms; LDA: global RGB histograms, 2,048 2{,}048 dimensions); NLBP: LDA on its 48 pooled histogram features. Bold : best of each accuracy column. For reference, Kather et al. [2016] reported 87.4% with combined gray-level descriptors and an SVM under ten-fold cross-validation.
blocks.zh: 表6: Kather-CRC内分泌癌组织学(8个组织类,分层5倍交叉验证):精度(%),指±\pm标准偏差大于折叠. 古典描述符,PAPNet和NLPP如表4(古典化:最佳 2\chi^{2}标准化1-NN;c:RGB输入). FLEX-LBP 后处理后的描述符,每叠一个训练运行. LDA:每个描述符上3.8节的缩写LDA,其输入量与其1-NN变体相同;PAPNet:其每个列(1-NN列:RGB块直方图上的线性SVM)中的最佳变体;LDA:全球RGB直方图,2,048 2{,}048维);NLAP:其48集合直方图特征上的LDA. 粗体:每个精度列中最优. 参见Kather等人. [2016年]报告87.4%,加在一起的灰色水平描述符和一个SVM在10倍的交叉验证下.

blocks.en:
Learning improves the Fixed descriptor under the standardized 1-NN readout.
Geometry gains + 1.10 +1.10 pp ( p = 3.9 × 10 − 5 p{=}3.9{\times}10^{-5} ) and All joint + 1.64 +1.64 pp ( p = 1.9 × 10 − 9 p{=}1.9{\times}10^{-9} ), and All joint is also significantly more accurate than Geometry ( p = 0.04 p{=}0.04 ).
All joint reaches 93.82 ± 0.83 % 93.82\pm 0.83\% , significantly above the strongest classical descriptor, CLBP on the RGB channels with χ 2 \chi^{2} matching ( 92.80 ± 0.80 % 92.80\pm 0.80\% , p = 0.014 p{=}0.014 ).
Geometry ( p = 0.27 p{=}0.27 ) and the Fixed descriptor ( p = 0.16 p{=}0.16 ) are statistically tied with CLBP, and the learned PCANet and NLBP stay far below ( p < 10 − 50 p{<}10^{-50} against both learned FLEX-LBP configurations).
With LDA, the three FLEX-LBP descriptors reach 93.9–94.5%, and the learning gain is no longer significant (Geometry − 0.12 -0.12 pp, p = 0.70 p{=}0.70 ; All joint + 0.52 +0.52 pp, p = 0.07 p{=}0.07 ).
The other descriptors stay below them with this readout, which lowers CLBP on the RGB channels and NLBP (Table 6 ).
The three FLEX-LBP descriptors are significantly more accurate than the strongest classical descriptor with LDA, MRELBP on the RGB channels (90.44%), and than PCANet and NLBP ( p < 10 − 17 p{<}10^{-17} ).
blocks.zh:
学习改进了标准化的1-NN读取下的固定描述符.
几何增益+1.10 +1.10 pp(p=3.9×10 → 5 p{=}3.9{\时}10^{5}),全联合+1.64+1.64 pp(p=1.9×10 → 9 p{=}1.9{\时}10^{-9}),全联合也明显比几何准确(p=0.04 p{=}0.04).
所有联合体达到93.82±0.83% 93.82\pm 0.83\\%,明显高于最强的古典描述符,CLBP在RGB频道上与 \\ 2\chi\2}匹配(92.80±0.80% 92.80\pm 0.80+,p=0.014 p=0.014).
几何学(p = 0.27 p{=}0.27)和固定描述符(p = 0.16 p{=}0.16)在统计上与CLBP捆绑在一起,所学的PAPNet和NLPP远远低于(p < 10 - 50 p{<}10^{-50),而两者的FLEX-LBP配置都是相对的.
与LDA相比,FLEX-LBP的三种描述值达到93.9–94.5%,学习收益不再显著(Geometry − 0.12–0.12 pp,p = 0.70 p + 0.70;All joint + 0.52+ 0.52 pp,p = 0.07 p + 0.07).
其他描述者则保留在下方的读出处,这降低了在RGB频道上的CLBP和NLP(表6).
FLEX-LBP的三种描述语比最强的古典描述语(LDA),RGB频道的MRELBP(90.44%),以及PAPNet和NLPP( < 10 - 17 p - 10 - 17)都要准确得多。

blocks.en:
Color matters on this benchmark: CLBP is 3.3 pp more accurate on the RGB channels than on the gray image (Table 6 ).
Gray-world input, which rescued TC34, costs the Fixed descriptor 3.0 pp here (Supplementary Section S15).
Stain color is informative and constant within this single-center benchmark, so normalizing it away removes information.
blocks.zh:
这个基准上的颜色事项:CLBP在RGB频道上比灰色图像上更准确(表6).
格雷-世界输入(Gray-world investment),它拯救了TC34,在此花费了固定描述器3.0pp(补充部分S15).
沉着的颜色在这个单中心基准内是信息化的和恒定的,因此使其正常化可以去除信息.

blocks.en: 4.10 Comparison with frozen pretrained CNN features
blocks.zh: 4.10 与冻结的CNN预训功能的比较

blocks.en:
Frozen features of ImageNet-pretrained CNNs are a standard deep reference in color texture classification [ Cimpoi et al., 2016 , Bello-Cerezo et al., 2019 ] .
In the comparison of Bello-Cerezo et al. [2019] , the globally pooled ResNet-50 features that we use ranked first among 68 hand-crafted and CNN-based descriptors.
We extract them, without fine-tuning, from a ResNet-50 [ He et al., 2016 ] with its original ImageNet weights, trained on the 1.28 million labeled images of ImageNet [ Russakovsky et al., 2015 ] .
We resize each 128 × 128 128{\times}128 input image to 224 × 224 224{\times}224 and read out the 2,048 2{,}048 -dimensional pooled features by the same standardized 1-NN and shrinkage LDA as FLEX-LBP, on the same splits and test images.
Supplementary Section S18 details the extraction and shows that newer ImageNet weights and the native 128 × 128 128{\times}128 input are less accurate on average with both readouts.
Tables 7 and 8 report the accuracy and the cost of both descriptors.
blocks.zh:
ImageNet前置CNN的冷冻特性是颜色纹理分类的标准深度参考[Cimpoi等人,2016年,Bello-Cerezo等人,2019年].
在Bello-Cerezo等人[2019]的比较中,我们使用的全球集合的ResNet-50功能在68个手工制作和基于CNN的描述词中排名第一.
我们从ResNet-50[He et al., 2016]号照片中取出,
我们将每张128×128×128}128输入图像调整为224×224×224}224,并读出2,048 2{,}048的维集合特性,由相同的标准化1-NN和缩水LDA与FLEX-LBP一样,在相同的分割和测试图像上.
补充部分S18详细介绍了提取情况,并显示更新的ImageNet重量和原生128×128×128{\times}128输入在两种读取时均不准确.
表7和表8报告这两份说明的准确性和成本。

ResNet-50: a single run, since the frozen network has no training seed. Fixed: mean over its five color initializations; Geometry and All joint: means over five and three training seeds. Kather-CRC: mean over the five folds; Mean: over the six main benchmarks. ∗ : with the input-side remedy of Section 4.8 applied at inference without retraining (a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 median-filtered input on TC32 and a gray-world input on TC34). For FLEX-LBP, these are the seed-42 models of Table 5 ; seed 42 is also the most accurate Geometry seed on TC32 without a remedy (84.56% against a mean of 83.10%). NBT: NewBarkTex; KTH: KTH-TIPS2; PAQ: Parquet; USP: USPtex; Kather: Kather-CRC.
