blocks.en:
Averaged over the six main benchmarks, ResNet-50 reaches 80.85% with 1-NN and 86.74% with LDA, against 83.10% and 87.44% for Geometry and 83.23% and 89.07% for All joint.
With LDA, even the untrained Fixed descriptor is at its level (86.52%).
The LDA difference, however, comes from Parquet: on the other five benchmarks, ResNet-50 is ahead with LDA (93.56% against 90.44% for Geometry and 91.38% for All joint).
With 1-NN, Geometry stays ahead on these five (89.22% against 88.24%), mainly because of TC31.
Choosing the best of six ResNet-50 1-NN variants on each test split, as for the classical descriptors, yields a mean of 82.50%, still below Geometry and All joint (Supplementary Section S18).
blocks.zh:
在六个主要基准中,ResNet-50平均达到80.85%,有1-NN,有86.74%,而几何学为83.10%,87.44%,全民为83.23%和89.07%。
与LDA相比,即使未经训练的固定描述符也处于其水平(86.52%).
然而,LDA差异来自Parquet:在其他五个基准上,ResNet-50领先于LDA(93.56%比90.44%比91.38%比91.38%比91.38%比所有人比)。
随着1-NN的出现,几何学在这五个方面保持领先(89.22%对88.24%),这主要是因为TC31.
在每个测试分拆上选择六个ResNet-50 1-NN变种中最好的一个,与古典描述词一样,平均结果为82.50%,仍然低于几何和全联合(补充部分S18)。

blocks.en:
Significant differences occur in both directions (Supplementary Section S18 counts them per seed).
With 1-NN, ResNet-50 is significantly more accurate than Geometry on KTH-TIPS2 in four of the five seeds and on USPtex in two.
It is statistically tied with Geometry in every seed on NewBarkTex and TC13.
Conversely, it is significantly less accurate on TC31 in all five seeds and on Parquet in one.
All joint is significantly ahead of it in all three seeds on Parquet and NewBarkTex.
With LDA on the main benchmarks, ResNet-50 is significantly more accurate than Geometry on KTH-TIPS2 in all five seeds and on NewBarkTex in three.
It is also significantly more accurate than All joint on KTH-TIPS2 in all three seeds.
Both FLEX-LBP descriptors are significantly ahead on TC31 and Parquet in every seed, and the other tests are ties.
The two largest of these differences thus point in opposite directions: the CNN features lead on KTH-TIPS2, whose test images come from an unseen physical sample, and FLEX-LBP leads on Parquet.
This pattern agrees with the large comparison of Bello-Cerezo et al. [2019] .
There, off-the-shelf CNN features were markedly better on average, especially on non-stationary textures and under several acquisition changes, whereas hand-crafted descriptors were better on stationary textures under steady imaging conditions.
blocks.zh:
两个方向都存在重大差异(补充部分S18按种子计算)。
使用1-NN,ResNet-50在KTH-TIPS2上在5个种子中的4个种子上和USPtex上在2个种子上比几何更精确得多.
在统计学上,它与NewBarkTex和TC13上每个种子的几何相联。
相反,在所有五个种子中,TC31和Parquet的准确度都低得多。
所有关节在Parquet和NewBarkTex上的所有三种种子中都显著领先.
由于LDA在主要基准上,ResNet-50在所有5个种子中比几何学的KTH-TIPS2和在NewBarkTex的3个种子中要精确得多.
在所有三种种子中,它也比KTH-TIPS2上的所有关节更准确。
FLEX-LBP的描述符在TC31上和每个种子的Parquet上都显著领先,其他测试都是关联.
其中最大的两个区别由此指向了相反的方向:CNN的特征在KTH-TIPS2上领先,其测试图像来自一个看不见的物理样本,FLEX-LBP则在Parquet上领先.
这种模式与Bello-Cerezo等人[2019]的大规模比较一致.
在那里,有线电视新闻网的现成功能平均明显好一些,特别是在非固定纹理和若干购置变更的情况下,而手工制作的描述器在固定成像条件下的固定纹理方面更好。

blocks.en:
Without a remedy, the CNN features are far more robust to the two photometric shifts than our color descriptor, and significantly more accurate than Geometry in every seed on both suites.
With the same input remedies, the order reverses (Table 7 , rows marked ∗ ).
With a median-filtered input, ResNet-50 is significantly less accurate on TC32 than the Geometry model of seed 42 with the same input ( p = 4.5 × 10 − 8 p{=}4.5{\times}10^{-8} ) and statistically tied with the Fixed descriptor ( p = 0.18 p{=}0.18 ).
With a gray-world input, it is far less accurate on TC34 than the Fixed descriptor and the Geometry model with the same input ( p < 10 − 34 p{<}10^{-34} ).
Its best input on this suite, luminance, also stays below them (85.99%, Supplementary Section S18).
The CNN features thus absorb part of each nuisance without a remedy but gain much less from it.
The difference arises because the failures of our descriptor lie in specific comparisons that the remedies repair (Section 4.8 ).
blocks.zh:
没有补救办法,CNN的功能在两个光度变化中比我们的颜色描述器强得多,在两个套房的每个种子中都比几何更准确得多.
使用同样的输入补救方法,顺序倒置(表7,划为*行)。
使用中位过滤输入,ResNet-50在TC32上的精确度明显低于相同输入的42号种子的几何模型(p=4.5×10−8 p{=}4.5{\times}10^{-8}),统计上与固定描述符(p=0.18 p{=}0.18)绑定.
有了灰色世界的输入,在TC34上远不如固定描述符和同样输入的几何模型(p < 10 - 34 p{<}10^{-34})准确.
它对这个套房的最佳投入,光辉,也停留在它们下面(85.99%,补充部分S18).
CNN的功能吸收了其中一部分的烦恼,
产生这种差异的原因是,我们描述的失败在于具体的比较,即补救修复(第4.8节)。

blocks.en:
On Kather-CRC, the three FLEX-LBP descriptors are significantly more accurate than ResNet-50 with 1-NN ( p < 10 − 12 p{<}10^{-12} ).
With LDA, All joint is significantly more accurate ( p = 6.6 × 10 − 4 p{=}6.6{\times}10^{-4} ), whereas Geometry and the Fixed descriptor are statistically tied with ResNet-50 ( p = 0.13 p{=}0.13 and 0.06 0.06 ).
blocks.zh:
在Kather-CRC上,三个FLEX-LBP描述语比ResNet-50和1-NN更精确(p < 10 - 12 p{<}10^{-12}).
与LDA, 所有关节的准确度明显提高(p=6.6×10 − 4 p{=}6.6{\times}10^{-4}),而几何和固定描述符则在统计上与ResNet-50(p=0.13 p{=}0.13和0.06 0.06)绑定.

blocks.en:
The two descriptors differ by orders of magnitude in parameters, training data and storage, but much less in extraction time (Table 8 ).
The CNN needs about 4 billion multiply–adds per 224 × 224 224{\times}224 image [ He et al., 2016 ] .
At the native 128 × 128 128{\times}128 input, which is 0.8–0.9 pp less accurate on average (Supplementary Section S18), it would need about a third of them.
blocks.zh:
两种描述词在参数、培训数据和存储方面按数量顺序不同,但在提取时间方面则不同(表8)。
CNN需要约40亿乘数—每224×224×224×时}224图像[He et al., 2016].
在本地的128×128 128}128输入中,平均为0.8-0.9页(补充部分S18),大约需要三分之一。

blocks.en:
A frozen ImageNet ResNet-50 is thus a strong reference on natural material images and, without input remedies, under photometric shifts.
It does not, however, dominate an LBP whose 60 to 87 parameters are learned from 114 to 4,000 4{,}000 images.
Fine-tuned and larger backbones are outside this comparison (Section 5.4 ).
blocks.zh:
因此,冻结的ImageNet ResNet-50是对自然材料图像的有力参考,在没有输入补救的情况下,是在光度变化下。
但是,它并不支配一个LBP,它的60到87个参数是从114到4000 4{,}000的图像中得知的.
精细和大型骨干不属于这一比较范围(第5.4节)。

blocks.en: 5 Analysis and discussion
blocks.zh: 5 分析和讨论

blocks.en: 5.1 Which components matter where, and why
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 哪些组成部分在什么地方和为什么重要

blocks.en:
The training dynamics partly explain the dataset-dependent results of Section 4.4 .
On the NewBarkTex All joint run, the mean gradient norms of the color transform and the thresholds are about 290 and 275 times that of the radii (Supplementary Table S3).
These norms, not corrected for tensor size or units, measure sensitivity rather than step size, since Adam normalizes the step of each parameter.
Both components act directly on the intensities that feed all K × 9 = 72 K{\times}9=72 channel-pair comparisons of a pixel.
Small changes to them therefore reshape the histograms substantially, consistent with the disruptive effect of isolated color learning.
The radius acts only through the bilinear interpolation of the sampling positions, where sub-pixel shifts change the sampled intensities little.
Radius learning therefore appears limited less by the importance of scale than by the weakness of the signal that reaches it.
blocks.zh:
培训动态部分解释了第4.4节所依赖的数据集结果。
在 NewBarkTex 上 所有联合运行,颜色变换和阈值的平均梯度规范大约是弧度的290倍和275倍(补充表S3)。
这些规范,没有针对变压器大小或单位进行校正,而是测量灵敏度而不是步骤大小,因为亚当使每个参数的步态正常化.
这两个组件都直接作用于所有K×9=72 K\tims}9=72通道-pair比对像素的强度.
因此,对它们的微小改变在很大程度上重塑了直方图,与孤立的色彩学习的破坏性作用是一致的。
半径只通过采样位置的双线内插作用,其中子像素转动会改变采样强度小.
因此,半径学习似乎较少受到规模重要性的限制,而较少受到到达它的信号的弱点的限制。

blocks.en: 5.2 Learned parameters are interpretable and reproducible
blocks.zh: 5.2 可解释和可复制已知参数

blocks.en: Fig. 4 decodes the sampling geometry that Geometry learns on every benchmark (seed 42).
blocks.zh: 图4解码了几何在每个基准上学习的采样几何(种子42).

TC31 and TC32 share their training images and schedule, so they share one model; the bottom-left panel shows Kather-CRC (fold 0). Dotted ring and open circles: classical 8-neighbor initialization, scaled to the same size in every panel; filled dots: learned positions at radii r b , k r_{b,k} and angles θ b , k \theta_{b,k} , joined to their initial positions by thin lines and colored by the signed threshold ω b , k \omega_{b,k} on a square-root scale shared by all panels (red positive, blue negative); shaded band: range of the learned mean radius of the branch over the five seeds (Kather-CRC: over the five folds). The labels show the initial and learned mean radius of each branch in pixels for the plotted run.

blocks.en:
The coarse radius grows in all five seeds on the Outex training set shared by TC31, TC32 and TC34 (10.00 to 10.21 ± 0.16 10.21\pm 0.16 pixels with the 12-epoch schedule; Supplementary Section S14).
It shrinks in all five seeds on NewBarkTex, KTH-TIPS2 and Parquet, in all five folds of Kather-CRC (10.00 to 9.39 ± 0.08 9.39\pm 0.08 ) and in four of five seeds on USPtex.
TC13 has no consistent direction (three of five seeds grow).
The fine radius shrinks in every run but one, which may reflect a preference of the training objective as much as the data (Supplementary Section S4).
A coarse radius that grows on one training set and shrinks on others cannot be explained that way.
The mean threshold grows from the fine to the coarse branch on every benchmark except KTH-TIPS2, whose fine branch learns the largest thresholds.
On Kather-CRC tiles, the learned thresholds remove most irregular, noise-like codes and specialize the branches (Fig. 5 ; Supplementary Section S7).
blocks.zh:
粗体半径生长在TC31,TC32和TC34共用的Outex训练场上的所有5个种子中(10:00–10.21±0.16 10.21\pm0.16像素与12世纪时刻表;补充部分S14).
它在NewBarkTex,KTH-TIPS2和Parquet上的所有5个种子中收缩,在Kather-CRC上的所有5个折叠种子中收缩(10:00–9.39±0.08 9.39\pm 0.08),在USPtex上的所有5个种子中收缩4个.
TC13没有一致的方向(5个种子中有3个生长).
精细半径每跑一次都会缩小,这可能与数据一样反映出训练目标的偏好(补充部分S4)。
粗糙的半径,在一个训练场上生长,而在其他训练场上缩小,不能这样解释。
除KTH-TIPS2外,每个基准上的平均阈值从细到粗的分支都有增长,其精细分支学习的阈值最大.
在Kather-CRC瓷砖上,所学的阈值去除最不规则的类似噪声的代码,并专门使用分支(图5;补充部分S7)。

blocks.en:
Angular spacing departs from uniform by at most about 19 ∘ 19^{\circ} on average over seeds, and the longest sampling radius of a branch exceeds its shortest by about 20% at most.
This closeness to the initialization is partly by design (bounded radii, ℒ geom \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{geom}} ), so the informative finding is the direction of adaptation rather than its size.
Because all these quantities are explicit, bounded parameters, a practitioner can inspect whether each learned change is physically plausible, which end-to-end learned alternatives do not allow.
blocks.zh:
角距平均在种子上偏离约19 ∘ 19^{\circ),分支最长的采样半径最多超过其最短的采样半径约20%.
与初始化的这种接近部分是通过设计(rodi,L geom\mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{geom}}}),所以信息化的发现是适应的方向而不是大小.
由于所有这些数量都是明确的、有限度的参数,从业者可以检查每个学到的改变在物理上是否合理,哪一种端到端的学习方法是不允许的。

blocks.en:
The learned color transforms tell a parallel story (Supplementary Fig. S1).
The coarse branch of the USPtex Mixer+Q run becomes opponent-color-like, and the fine branch of All joint acts as a crude stain axis in every Kather-CRC fold.
blocks.zh:
所学的颜色变换讲述了一个平行的故事(补充图. S1).
USPtex混音器的粗分支+ Q跑变成对手-颜色相似,所有关节的细枝节在每一个Kather-CRC折叠中都起到粗糙的污纹轴的作用.

blocks.en: 5.3 Limits of learning and of the 1-NN readout
blocks.zh: 5.3 学习限制和1NN阅读限制

blocks.en:
Learning more parameters can hurt: All joint is below Threshold on TC32 and TC34 (Table 2 ) and, with 1-NN, significantly below the Fixed descriptor on KTH-TIPS2 and TC34 in all three seeds (Table 3 ).
Their test images come from an unseen physical sample (KTH-TIPS2) or add noise or an illuminant absent from the training images (TC32 and TC34).
The jointly learned components can therefore fit properties of the training images that do not hold at test time.
A learned color transform, in particular, mixes the channels, so even its intra-channel comparisons become partly inter-channel ones, the comparisons that an illuminant change flips (Section 4.8 ).
blocks.zh:
学习更多的参数会伤害: 所有关节在TC32和TC34(表2)上都低于阈值,在1-NN下,在所有三个种子中都明显低于KTH-TIPS2和TC34上的固定标注(表3).
他们的测试图像来自一个看不见的物理样本(KTH-TIPS2),或者在训练图像(TC32和TC34)中添加噪音或闪光剂.
因此,共同学习的组件可以适应在测试时不持有的训练图像的特性。
特别是学习到的颜色转化会混合频道,所以即使是其频道内部的比较也会部分变成频道间比较,这种比较是明亮的变化翻转(第4.8节).

blocks.en:
Learning adapts the operator to the training images but cannot create an invariance to a change that they do not contain.
An invariance must come from the operator or its input (median sampling in MRELBP, luminance input in gray-level descriptors) or from training data that contain the change.
The color pairs of FLEX-LBP are deliberately not invariant: the inter-channel contrasts that make it strong on natural color textures and histology (Sections 4.7 and 4.9 ) are what an illuminant change perturbs.
The remedies of Section 4.8 , like the image-relative magnitude code, are therefore choices of invariance rather than corrections of the learning, to be made from the nuisance expected at deployment.
blocks.zh:
学习可以使操作员适应训练图像,但不能对其中不包含的改变产生偏差.
变化必须来自操作员或其输入(MRELBP中的中间取样、灰色水平描述符中的亮度输入)或包含变化的培训数据。
FLEX-LBP的色彩配对是故意的,不是不变化的:使它在自然色彩纹理和神学(第4.7节和第4.9节)上坚固的跨通道对比是闪亮的改变扰动的东西.
因此,第4.8节的补救办法与图像相对星等编码一样,是因部署时预期的烦扰而作出的变化而不是对学习的纠正。

blocks.en:
On NewBarkTex, TC13, Parquet and USPtex, LDA exceeds 1-NN for all three descriptors of Table 3 , by up to 23.34 pp, so standardized 1-NN leaves discriminative information unused.
Because the untrained descriptor shows the same gap, it reflects mainly the readout and not the training objective, and vanilla NCA does not close it either (Supplementary Section S3).
Learning narrows it on TC13, Parquet and USPtex, but the proxy loss favors linearly separable class prototypes, whereas 1-NN rewards low intra-class variance.
On KTH-TIPS2 and the suites with a controlled train/test change, the difference is near zero or negative for Fixed and more negative for Geometry (Supplementary Section S20).
This is consistent with a decision boundary fitted under the training conditions.
blocks.zh:
在NewBarkTex,TC13,Parquet和USPtex上,表3的所有三个描述词LDA都超过了1-NN,最高为23.34页,因此标准化的1-NN留下了未使用的歧视性信息.
由于未经训练的描述符显示的空隙相同,它主要反映了读出而非训练目标,而香草NCAA也没有关闭(补充部分S3).
学习在TC13,Parquet和USPtex上缩小了范围,但代理损失偏好线性分离的类原型,而1-NN则奖励低级内部差异.
在KTH-TIPS2和具有可控列车/测试变化的套房上,固定式的差值接近0或负数,几何式的差值更负数(补充部分S20).
这符合在训练条件下划定的决定边界。

blocks.en:
With LDA on both descriptors, the gain of Geometry shrinks from + 3.55 +3.55 to + 0.92 +0.92 pp on average, and that of All joint, paired over its three seeds, from + 3.69 +3.69 to + 2.68 +2.68 pp (Section 4.5 ).
Fixed read out by LDA is more accurate than Geometry read out by 1-NN, on average (86.52% against 83.10%) and on each of NewBarkTex, TC13, Parquet and USPtex.
With LDA on both sides, the gain of All joint over Fixed is significant in 10 of its 18 seed-level tests, against only 6 of 30 for Geometry.
These results suggest that learning the geometry mainly improves the neighborhood structure that nearest-neighbor matching uses directly.
On natural color textures, a supervised linear readout appears to recover much of the same separability from the fixed descriptor.
Learning the color transform as well adds accuracy that the linear readout does not recover, mainly on Parquet, NewBarkTex and TC31, but costs accuracy under the photometric shifts.
blocks.zh:
由于在两种描述符上都有LDA,因此几何学的增益平均从+3.55+3.55缩到+0.92+0.92pp,所有关节的增益则在其三种种子上对齐,从+3.69+3.69到+2.68+2.68pp(第4.5节).
LDA的固定读出比1-NN读出几何更准确,平均(86.52%对83.10%)以及NewBarkTex,TC13,Parquet和USPtex的每个读出.
由于双方都有LDA,在18个种子级测试中,All Joint over Fixd的增益相当大,而几何测试的增益只有6个.
这些结果表明,学习几何主要改善了近邻匹配直接使用的邻里结构.
在自然颜色纹理上,有监督的线性读取似乎从固定的描述符中恢复了大部分相同的分离性.
学习颜色变换也增加了线性读出不能恢复的精度,主要在Parquet, NewBarkTex和TC31上,但在光度变化下成本精度.

blocks.en: 5.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.4 限制

blocks.en:
We do not rerun the adaptive SPALBP [ Hu et al., 2024 ] and SARLBP [ Upadhyay et al., 2025 ] , for which we found no public implementation.
Nor do we rerun CNN-based texture classifiers (Deep TEN [ Zhang et al., 2017 ] , bilinear CNNs [ Lin et al., 2015 ] ) or backbone-based encoders (RADAM [ Scabini et al., 2023 ] ).
We do not fine-tune ResNet-50, although several of our training sets are large enough for fine-tuning to be common practice.
We also do not encode its intermediate layers with Fisher vectors [ Cimpoi et al., 2016 ] or try larger, newer or transformer backbones.
The frozen features are thus a lower bound, and fine-tuned models can be expected to keep an advantage that this paper does not aim to overturn.
NLBP, designed as a layer for deep backbones, is measured standalone, as a learned LBP descriptor.
blocks.zh:
我们没有重新运行适应性的SPALBP[Hu等人,2024年]和SARLBP[Upadhyay等人,2025年],我们发现没有公开执行。
我们也不重新运行基于CNN的纹理分类器(Deep TEN [Zhang等人,2017],双线CNNs [Lin等人,2015])或基于骨干编码器(RADAM [Scabini等人,2023]).
我们并不对ResNet-50进行微调,尽管我们的几套培训足够大,可以进行微调,使其成为常见做法。
我们还不用费舍尔矢量编码其中间层[Cimpoi等人,2016年],也不尝试更大的,更新的或变压器骨干.
因此,被冻结的特征是一种较低的约束,经过微调的模型可望保持本文无意推翻的优势。
设计为深层骨干层的NLPP作为学习型LBP描述器被单独测量.

blocks.en:
The four learned configurations other than Geometry and All joint use one seed, so their 1–2 pp differences should be read with caution.
Outex, KTH-TIPS2 and NewBarkTex define a single official split; three random splits of Parquet and USPtex confirm the main conclusions on Fixed and All joint (Supplementary Section S5).
The recommended Geometry configuration was identified from the seed-42 ablation, so only the additional seeds and Kather-CRC test it independently.
The radius templates were set per dataset with test results visible.
Swapping them changes the absolute accuracy by up to 4.4 pp but not the sign of the learning gain (Supplementary Section S16).
TC32 and TC34 were separated from the main benchmarks after their diagnosis but appear in every table.
blocks.zh:
除几何和所有联合外的四种学习的配置使用一个种子,所以他们的1-2pp差异应谨慎阅读.
Outex, KTH- TIPS2 和 NewBarkTex 定义了单一的官方拆分; Parquet 和 USPtex 的三个随机拆分证实了关于固定和全部联合(补充部分S5)的主要结论.
推荐的几何配置是从种子-42衰变中鉴定出来的,因此只有附加种子和Kather-CRC独立测试.
半径模板是每个数据集设定的,测试结果可见.
撕毁它们会改变绝对准确性,最高可达4.4页,但不会改变学习收益的标志(补充部分S16)。
TC32和TC34在诊断后与主要基准分离,但出现在每个表格中。

blocks.en:
FLEX-LBP has no built-in invariance to illuminant color or to noise larger than the texture contrast, and each remedy costs accuracy where its nuisance is absent.
The remedies were found by diagnosing the two test suites, so their accuracies are not held-out results; PCANet remains ahead on TC34.
blocks.zh:
FLEX-LBP对光亮的颜色或大于纹理对比的噪声没有内在的偏差,在没有扰动时,每种补救方法都花费了准确性。
通过诊断两套测试套房找到了补救办法,因此其精度没有被搁置;PAPNet在TC34上仍然领先。

blocks.en:
Kather-CRC is a single-center benchmark, evaluated as in its original study with tile-level folds that share slides between training and test.
Our histology results therefore do not measure generalization to new patients, centers or stains, which the multicenter follow-up dataset of Kather et al. [2019] would allow.
blocks.zh:
Kather-CRC是一个单中心基准,在最初的研究中被评价为在培训和测试之间共享幻灯片的瓦片级折叠.
因此,我们的组织学结果不能衡量对新病人、中心或污点的概括,这是Kather等人的多中心后续数据集。 [2019] 将允许。

blocks.en:
Our image-relative magnitude code discards the absolute size of the differences, a strong class cue on TC31 and Parquet.
There, fixed LTP coding is more accurate than Geometry, significantly in some seeds (Section 4.7 ).
Recoding the trained Geometry model with an absolute threshold, without retraining, raises Parquet and TC31 but lowers five of the eight benchmarks (Supplementary Section S17).
blocks.zh:
我们的图像相对量码 放弃了绝对的大小差异, 一个强大的类提示 TC31 和 Parquet。
在那里,固定的LTP编码比几何更准确,在某些种子中显著(第4.7节).
用绝对阈值重新编码训练的几何模型,不进行再培训,提高Parquet和TC31,但降低了8个基准中的5个(补充部分S17)。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present FLEX-LBP, an LBP whose color transform, radii, angles, thresholds and quantization can be learned by backpropagation, while straight-through estimation keeps every forward pass a hard-binary LBP.
blocks.zh: 我们提出FLEX-LBP,一种LBP,它的颜色变换,光度,角度,阈值和量子化可以通过反向传播来学习,而直径估计则使每一个前方都通过硬二进制LBP.

blocks.en:
(Q1) Which components are worth learning depends on the dataset, and the best configuration of each benchmark can only be identified on its test split.
One configuration is nevertheless robust: learning the geometry and the thresholds with the color transform frozen.
Over five seeds, it improves the 1-NN accuracy of the identical fixed descriptor by + 3.55 +3.55 pp on average, significantly on five of the six main benchmarks and never significantly worse.
It also improves the 1-NN accuracy of the fixed descriptor on colorectal histology ( + 1.10 +1.10 pp), a benchmark added after this configuration was chosen.
Learning everything can gain more on small, specialized datasets (Parquet, + 15.50 +15.50 pp over three seeds) but, with 1-NN, loses consistently on KTH-TIPS2, and the color transform learned alone is never best.
blocks.zh:
(Q1)哪些组件值得学习取决于数据集,每个基准的最佳配置只能根据其测试分解来识别.
一种配置尽管如此坚固:用颜色变冷来学习几何和阈值.
超过5个种子,它提高了相同固定描述符的1-NN精度,平均每页+3.55+3.55,在6个主要基准中的5个有显著提高,而且从未出现过显著的差.
它还提高了直肠组织学上固定描述符的1-NN精度(+1.10+1.10pp),这是在选择这个配置后添加的基准.
学习一切可以在小型的,专门的数据集(Parquet,+15.50+15.50 pp通过三个种子)上获得更多收益,但随着1-NN,在KTH-TIPS2上持续失利,单独学习的颜色变换从来就是最好.

blocks.en:
(Q2) Postprocessing adds + 2.02 +2.02 pp to the fixed descriptor on average over the six main benchmarks, and the learning gain persists after it.
Fixed and learned descriptors can therefore only be compared fairly under identical postprocessing.
The readout matters as much: with a shrinkage LDA instead of 1-NN, the gain of Geometry falls to + 0.92 +0.92 pp on average and that of All joint to + 2.68 +2.68 pp.
LDA lifts the fixed descriptor above the learned geometry read out by 1-NN on four benchmarks and lowers the accuracy of the learned geometry on KTH-TIPS2 and TC31.
This suggests that learning the geometry mainly improves the neighborhood structure on which nearest-neighbor matching relies.
blocks.zh:
(Q2) 后处理平均比六个主要基准在固定描述中增加+2.02+2.02页,学习收益在之后持续.
因此,只有在相同的邮政处理下,才能公平地比较固定的和学习过的说明。
读出同样重要:随着LDA的收缩而不是1-NN,几何学的增益平均下降到+ 0.92+0.92页,All joint的增益下降到+ 2.68+2.68页.
LDA将1-NN在4个基准上读出的学习几何之上的固定描述符提升,降低KTH-TIPS2和TC31上学习几何的准确性.
这表明,学习几何主要可以改善近邻匹配所依赖的邻里结构.

blocks.en:
(Q3) The learned operator remains interpretable: its radii, angles, thresholds and color transforms are explicit, bounded or regularized parameters.
Their direction of adaptation, such as a coarse radius that grows on one training set and shrinks on others, recurs across seeds and folds.
blocks.zh:
(问题3) 学习的操作员仍然可以解释:其射线,角度,阈值和颜色变换都是明确,有界限或规范化的参数.
它们的适应方向,如粗的半径,在一个训练场上生长,在其它训练场上收缩,在种子和折叠之间反复出现.

blocks.en:
Within the LBP family, FLEX-LBP is more accurate than five classical descriptors, PCANet and NLBP on five of the six main benchmarks.
With LDA on every descriptor, it is again ahead on five of the six, but MRELBP then leads on KTH-TIPS2.
On colorectal histology, the fully learned descriptor reaches 93.82%, significantly above the best classical descriptor (CLBP, 92.80%), and 94.50% with LDA (MRELBP, 90.44%).
A fixed LTP coding matches Geometry on average, and most of its advantage over our code comes from its absolute dead zone.
This dead zone keeps the absolute size of the differences, mostly color differences between channels, that our image-relative magnitude code discards.
Under additive noise and illuminant change (TC32 and TC34), single-pixel comparisons drown and comparisons between channels flip.
Input-side remedies restore 96–97%, level with BSIF (PCANet stays ahead on TC34), but each costs accuracy where its nuisance is absent.
blocks.zh:
在LBP家族中,FLEX-LBP在六个主要基准中的五个基准上比五个古典描述符更准确. PCAPNet和NLAPP.
每个描述符上都有LDA,再次领先于六位中五位,但MRELBP随后领先于KTH-TIPS2.
在直肠组织学方面,完全学习的描述语达到93.82%,大大高于最佳的古典描述语(CLBP,92.80%),94.50%与LDA(MRELBP,90.44%)。
一个固定的LTP编码平均匹配几何,它相对于我们代码的大部分优势来自于它的绝对死区.
这个死区保留了我们图像相对量码所丢弃的区别的绝对大小,大多是通道之间的颜色差异.
在添加性噪音和光亮变化(TC32和TC34)下,单像素比较溺死,通道翻转之间的比较.
输入方补救措施恢复了96–97 %,与BSIF(PCANet在TC34上保持领先)的水平,但如果没有扰动,则每个成本精确度都很高。

blocks.en:
Frozen ResNet-50 features (23.5 million parameters) are less accurate than Geometry on average with 1-NN and similar with LDA.
With LDA, All joint has the highest mean (89.07%), a lead that rests on Parquet.
They are more accurate on KTH-TIPS2, USPtex and, with LDA, NewBarkTex, and less accurate on TC31, Parquet and, with 1-NN, histology.
They are also more robust to the photometric shifts without input remedies but fall below the best remedied FLEX-LBP descriptor with them.
blocks.zh:
冷冻ResNet-50特性(2350万个参数)的准确度低于平均1-NN的几何,与LDA类似.
与LDA, 所有关节的中间值最高(89.07%),领先于Parquet.
在KTH-TIPS2, USPtex以及LDA, NewBarkTex上,它们比较准确,在TC31, Parquet和1-NN上,它们比较准确。
在没有输入补救方法的光度变化中,它们也更强,但低于最佳补救的FLEX-LBP描述符。

blocks.en:
In practice, without a reliable validation set, we recommend the Geometry configuration.
The color transform should be learned jointly with it only where held-out data can confirm the gain.
With an LDA readout, this joint learning falls below the fixed descriptor under the photometric shifts.
The input normalization should follow the nuisance expected at deployment (Section 5.3 ).
A per-channel (gray-world) normalization suits a possible change of illuminant or stain, and a median sampling support suits noise that may exceed the texture contrast.
When color and fine detail are reliable, neither remedy is needed.
blocks.zh:
在实践中,如果没有可靠的验证集,我们推荐几何配置.
色彩变换只有在被搁置的数据能够确认增益时,才应与其共同学习.
通过LDA读取,这种联合学习在光度变化下低于固定描述符.
投入正常化应当遵循部署时预期的麻烦(第5.3节)。
每个通道(gray-world)的正常化适合光亮或污点的可能改变,中位采样支持适合可能超过纹理对比的噪声.
当色彩和细细的细节可靠时,就不需要补救.

blocks.en: Four directions follow from the limitations (Section 5.4 ; Supplementary Section S21): (i) photometric robustness that is not chosen by hand; (ii) a magnitude threshold that interpolates between image-relative and absolute forms with a learned weight; (iii) an objective or readout that uses what 1-NN leaves unused; and (iv) a histology evaluation with slide-level splits and external centers [ Kather et al., 2019 ] , and a comparison with fine-tuned and larger deep texture models.
blocks.zh: 4个方向来自这些限制(第5.4节;补充部分S21):(一) 光度强度不是手工选择的;(二) 规模阈值在图像相对形式和绝对形式之间以学习的重量进行插值;(三) 目标或读出使用1-NN留下的未使用内容;(四) 具有滑动平面分裂和外部中心的神学评价[Kather等人,2019],并与精细和更大的深纹模型进行比较。
